title: L1 Data Centre IT Technician
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

As an IT Datacenter Technician, you will play a vital role in maintaining and optimizing the IT infrastructure within our data center. This includes working hands-on with modern technologies such as the modern GPU cloud clusters. Your responsibilities will encompass supporting the data center’s IT infrastructure, troubleshooting and resolving hardware issues, and ensuring the smooth operation of critical systems. Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting and resolving hardware issues, performing hardware and network diagnostics, ensuring the smooth operation of critical systems, and carrying out physical repairs. The role may also involve travel between data centers and participation in on-call rotations.

You’re welcome to work at our data center.

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Monitor and support the IT infrastructure as a shift worker (day & night shifts).

  • Diagnose and resolve issues related to server and network hardware within the data center.

  • Perform installation, upgrades, and decommissioning of IT hardware in accordance with operational requirements.

  • Manage and maintain fiber optic and patch cable connectivity.

  • Handle Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) in compliance with company procedures and documentation.

  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve technical and operational issues.

  • Maintain and update documentation, manuals, and procedures related to hardware configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

Requirements:

  • Solid understanding of server and networking equipment.

  • Practical, hands-on experience with server hardware, network switches, and fiber optic cabling.

  • Proven ability to diagnose and resolve hardware-related issues.

  • A proactive, responsible, and results-driven work attitude.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Valid Category B driving license.

  • Basic knowledge of the Linux operating system and familiarity with command-line tools.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire. 

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Co-Investments & Partnerships Associate / Principal
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

TEAM OVERVIEW

KKR’s Co-Investments & Partnerships team is a growing, lean, and entrepreneurial group that leads co-investments alongside the firm’s investments across all asset classes globally, including Private Equity, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Credit, and Growth Equity. The team provides capital markets advice and develops and implements traditional and non-traditional capital solutions for KKR transactions seeking financing through co-investments and partnerships. It also acts as the firm-wide clearing house for secondary transactions, including GP-led continuation vehicles and LP-led fund and co-investment buybacks. The team plays an active role in Investment Committee meetings and offers significant exposure to senior leadership across the firm.

POSITION SUMMARY

KKR is seeking an Associate / Principal to join the Co-Investments & Partnerships team for an immediate start. The position will be based in London. This is a deal-focused role within a dynamic team, offering exposure to a broad range of transactions across KKR’s European portfolio. The role offers a long-term career path, with progression from deal support to deal leadership and beyond.

RESPONSIBILITIES


• Run co-investment processes for KKR portfolio companies across all European strategies including private equity, infrastructure, credit and real estate
• Support and lead all aspects of co-investment processes including close coordination with deal teams and relevant KKR stakeholders, materials preparation, presenting to investors, and Q&A
• Develop a deep understanding of each transaction from an investor perspective
• Lead calls with investors related to live transactions including presenting the deals and answering questions
• Build and maintain relationships with co-investors, limited partners, and other investors
• Collaborate closely with internal deal teams across asset classes and geographies


QUALIFICATIONS


KKR seeks to hire individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment, demonstrate strong ownership, and have a proven ability to combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution. The successful candidate will have:


• 3-6 years prior experience in investment banking or private equity investment teams / secondaries
• Highly motivated, proactive, detail-oriented, with a strong work ethic, sense of ownership, and interest in a long-term, career-track role
• Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, outcome-oriented environment
• Clear and effective communication of both qualitative and quantitative concepts
• Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with investors and internal stakeholders
• Strong analytical capabilities, including financial analysis and modelling skills
• Cultural fit with a collaborative, collegial, and entrepreneurial team environment

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time or Part-time | Permanent (or Temporary) | Hybrid 

Salary: £64,000 to £76,000, DOE  

The salary range for this role is broad, as we are able to consider varying levels of experience.  Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.

 

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.  

 

About the role: 

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, to join our Test Engineering team in Cambridge. You’ll test Riverlane’s QEC software from end to end, across Deltakit (our open-source Python SDK), our compiler and Deltaflow (our real-time quantum error correction system). 

This role suits a developer with some experience in quantum, who wants to move towards testing. You’ll write and maintain tests, and you’ll also think like a user: does this feature behave the way a customer would expect, and could it be easier to use? What you learn will feed directly into how we improve the product. 

 

What you will do (specific responsibilities) : 

  • Design, write and maintain Python tests (using pytest) across our QEC software stack, including Deltakit and the compiler front end 
  • Test features from the customer’s point of view, and check that your tests reflect how users will actually work with the product 
  • Spot where functionality could be clearer or easier to use, and propose improvements 
  • Share findings with engineering and product teams, and follow your suggestions through to changes in the product 
  • Work closely with developers to understand new features and plan how they should be tested 

 

What we need:

  • Knowledge of quantum computation and core concepts such as quantum circuits. One relevant project or piece of experience is enough (for example, building and running circuits with a framework such as Qiskit) 
  • Experience as a developer working on a product, either software or hardware, and an interest in moving towards test 
  • Strong Python skills. All the interfaces you’ll use day to day are in Python, from pytest to our compiler front end and Deltakit 
  • A user-focused mindset. You think about how functionality comes across to a customer and how it could be made easier to use 
  • A track record of suggesting improvements to a product or software library 

 

Even better if you have…

  • Knowledge of quantum error correction (QEC) 
  • Direct experience of testing software or hardware 

 

What can you expect from us 

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme  
  • Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane  
  • 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave  
  • A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities  
  • A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets 

  

How to apply 

Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking 'Apply'. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role. 

We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match. We do not use closing dates. So, please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role. 

 

If you have any queries, please contact com. 

 

Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity. 

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements.  If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply - you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you. 

If you need any adjustments made to the application or selection process so you can do your best, please let us know. We will be happy to help.

title: Senior Research Scientist, Health Economic Modelling
description:
Do you consider yourself a self-starter with a real passion for projects involving innovative methods in health economics and evidence synthesis? Do you love collaborating, moving the ball forward, and rolling up your sleeves? Are you a health economist with a passion for R programming?

If so – we want to talk to you!  We are growing and seeking a Senior Research Scientist with experience in building health economic models in R to join our Evidence Synthesis and Decision Modelling team. You will collaborate with a highly specialized team of health economists, statisticians and researchers in global, methodologically innovative projects for our pharma and biotech clients.

Why join us?

  • Innovative Culture: Experience the excitement of a start-up within a well-funded, established global organization.
  • Passionate Team: Work with a team that has a real passion for Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) and prides itself on being visionary leaders in the field.
  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a growing team that values collaboration and making a real difference in healthcare.

About you:

  • Experienced Health Economist: You have a background in health economics, statistics or a related field, HEOR experience, and a solid understanding of the pharmaceutical industry and drug reimbursement processes. You can interpret results of clinical and health economic studies independently, and lead the implementation of simulation-based cost-effectiveness analyses in R and Excel/VBA.
  • Modelling Research Experience: You have experience planning, programming and reporting R-based and Excel-based cost-effectiveness simulation models and applied knowledge of statistical methods in health economics. You can evaluate studies to identify key result drivers, assess data or methodological gaps and suggest solutions.
  • Deliverable Creation: You can program independently economic models in R and Excel/VBA from scratch, and contribute to the development of client-ready study deliverables including model conceptualization and analysis plans, interpretations of model results and sensitivity analyses, and technical reports.
  • Technical Proficiency: You demonstrate passion and expertise in R programming applied to health economic simulation modelling, as well as data analysis and visualization. You are proficient with collaborative versioning software (i.e., git/GitHub). You are an expert in Excel and Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) programming. You are skilled in preparing written documentation and presenting results using Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
  • Effective Communication: You can present progress and results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, either internally or externally.
  • Project and Time Management: You ensure timely delivery of project components, can work effectively individually and as part of a diverse team and have excellent independent organizational and time management skills.

Required Experience and Competencies:

  • Master’s degree in health economics or statistics, or a related discipline
  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant professional experience, ideally in a consulting environment serving biotech, pharmaceutical or healthcare clients
  • Proven R programming skills, experience with programming cost-effectiveness simulation models in R
  • Understanding of and experience in the application of statistical methods in health economics, e.g., parametric survival regression model extrapolation, network meta-analyses, probabilistic sensitivity analyses
  • Willingness and desire to learn and share knowledge
  • Strong multi-tasking and time management skills
  • Highly developed analytical reasoning and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work effectively individually and as part of a diverse team

Helpful Experience and Competencies:

  • Experience with Python, C++ or other programming languages
  • Experience with the hesim, shiny, Rcpp R packages
  • Experience with Bayesian statistics and advanced modelling techniques
  • Knowledge and experience in conducting indirect treatment comparisons such as network meta-analysis, matching-adjusted indirect comparison, and simulated treatment comparison

description: What we’re all about. We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges. At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you. The Opportunity Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days. You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits. Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests. Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value. The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people. What you’ll be doing Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner. Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports. Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams. Planning, coordinating and running annual Board offsite meetings. Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress. Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel. Handling the inevitable last-minute juggling that comes with supporting a team of busy, dedicated senior people. Requirements What you’ll bring. Organized and proactive: you juggle multiple projects at once without dropping any balls, take responsibility and create opportunity. Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen. Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across. Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients. Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support. Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are. Our mission. We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future. It’s all about you. We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q . We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist. No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you. title: Security and Compliance Engineer
description: About Griffin Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences. We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more. We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies. Learn more about what we do Our culture We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible. We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life. We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified. Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers. Learn more about our culture. The Team The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers. You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner . The Opportunity We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security. What Success Looks Like In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase. By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation. To Do This You’ll Own Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations We expect you to shape this role This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are. Your background To ensure this, we're looking for people who have: A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write ) Ideally, you would also: Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation What can we offer you? We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future. Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year) Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment. As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks. How do I apply? Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next. We’re remote-first We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it. Under representation At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance Griffin Bank Ltd request that recruitment agencies do not speculatively submit CVs to any employee or associate of our company unless explicitly asked to do so by a member of our Talent team. We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The Team

The Craft function has seven small, cross-functional engineering teams - each with engineers, an engineering manager, and a product manager, working closely with designers.

You will work across the whole Craft function, with the remit of improving our controls and cyber security governance. You will initially work with and report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure as you establish yourself and take on your day to day responsibilities, additionally you will work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Engineer 1.5 to become the engineering voice of security, compliance and assurance at Griffin. Sitting across engineering, security, risk and operational resilience, you'll turn standards and regulatory expectations into practical controls that engineers actually want to use and you’ll build those controls yourself, shipping code to production alongside the engineering team. You’ll also give our second and third lines real confidence in what we’ve built. It’s a rare hybrid role with broad ownership and a direct hand in strengthening Griffin’s security.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 6 months, you'll have taken ownership of our certification, attestation and audit work including ISO 27001 and SWIFT, with evidence organised and findings driven through to closure. Our engineering risks and controls will be well maintained, and our release, change and post-incident processes will be stronger. You’ll have shipped code that automates control checks and evidence collection, and you’ll be a regular contributor to our codebase.

By month 12 our resilience plans, including Important Business Service technical mapping, B& Continuity Planning and disaster recovery, will be current, and security and compliance will be easier to run and easier to demonstrate to customers, thanks to clearer ownership and smart automation.

To Do This You’ll Own

  • Control design and cyber security governance: translating standards into practical engineering controls and building and shipping the code that puts them in place, working with Engineering teams to get them live

  • Certifications and attestations, from SWIFT and FPS today to schemes like SOC 2 and ISO 27001 in the future, including the documentation behind them

  • Internal and external audits and customer due diligence requests, owning findings and driving them to closure

  • Engineering Risk and Controls Self Assessments, controls and actions, plus recurring control activity such as chaos testing and backup/restore

  • Code release and change management, improving the process and sampling releases to check adherence to policy

  • Post-incident reviews, including follow-up actions and sharing learnings with the right stakeholders

  • Engineering's contribution to operational resilience (DR plans and IBS technical mapping) and to managing engineering third parties alongside Operations

We expect you to shape this role

This description reflects what we need today. How you achieve these outcomes, where you focus your energy, how this role evolves—that's for you to define as you learn what our customers need and where our technical gaps are.

Your background

To ensure this, we're looking for people who have:

  • A hands-on engineering or technical background, including experience writing and shipping production code with an engineering-first approach to turning standards into practical controls and technical delivery

  • Experience in security, compliance, risk or assurance within a technical environment, including owning or significantly contributing to audits, certifications or attestations

  • Strong knowledge of compliance, risk and cyber security principles, and a broad understanding of change and release management, incident management, operational resilience and third-party governance

  • Sharp analytical and assurance skills: spotting gaps, assessing adherence to standards and following actions through

  • Stakeholder management and influencing skills across Engineering, SMEs, auditors and control functions, with a pragmatic, proportionate approach to governance

  • A love of writing - we have a major amount of written documentation that you will be contributing to, and we place a high degree of importance on clarity and readability (you can find out more here about how we write)

Ideally, you would also:

  • Be familiar with frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, SWIFT and FPS, ideally from a regulated fintech or challenger bank environment

  • Have used automation and code to improve security, compliance or control processes and documentation

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 25 days’ holiday, bank holidays and a winter break (we shut down between Christmas and New Year)

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

 

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We’re remote-first

We trust people to do great work wherever they are. We hire across the UK and most of our team works remotely full-time. We have a small London office in Moorgate for those who want it, and about a third of the company is close enough to use it occasionally, but there's no expectation to be there. What matters is the work, not where you do it.

Under representation

description: Pennylane ist ein französisches Fintech, das 2020 gegründet wurde und seinen Hauptsitz in Paris hat. Über 1,5 Millionen Unternehmen und 6.000 Steuerkanzleien auf der Plattform. 200 Mio. Euro jährlich wiederkehrender Umsatz (ARR) im Jahr 2025 – rund doppelt so viel wie im Vorjahr. 175 Mio. Euro Finanzierung im Januar 2026 bei einer Bewertung von 3,5 Mrd. Euro. Zu unseren Investoren zählen TCV, Blackstone, Sequoia, DST Global, CapitalG und Meritech. Expansion in Europa: Seit Ende 2025 sind wir in Deutschland aktiv. Die Einführung der E-Rechnung gibt der Digitalisierung des Finanzwesens zusätzlichen Rückenwind. Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit. Warum wir dich suchen Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt. Als Paid Marketing Manager Germany übernimmst du unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise von der Strategie bis zur Optimierung. Du machst aus Werbebudget qualifizierte Leads und behältst dabei die Kundenakquisekosten im Blick. Deine Mission Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS). Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen. Dein Team und Umfeld Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad . Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager . Für den deutschen Markt liegt Paid Acquisition vollständig in deiner Hand: Strategie, Budget, Umsetzung und Performance. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren internationalen und lokalen Teams zusammen: Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt. Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen. Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion. Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen. GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung. Deine Aufgaben 1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing. Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives. Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an. 2. Budget und Performance steuern Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele. Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt. Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab. 3. Wirkung messen und kontinuierlich optimieren Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter. Du testest laufend neue Creatives, Zielgruppen, Landingpages und Gebotsstrategien und überführst erfolgreiche Ansätze in die Skalierung. Mit dem Website-Team optimierst du die Landingpages und verbesserst die Conversion entlang des gesamten Funnels. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld. Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing. Operative Kanalexpertise: Du arbeitest sicher mit Google Ads und mindestens einer Paid-Social-Plattform wie LinkedIn oder Meta. Sicherheit bei Budget und Kennzahlen: Du kennst dich mit CAC, CPA, ROAS und CPL aus und weißt, wie du Budgets wirkungsvoll steuerst. Analytische Stärke: Attribution, Funnel-Analysen und Reporting-Tools gehören zu deinem Handwerkszeug. Du leitest aus Daten klare Entscheidungen ab. Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder zweisprachigem Niveau sowie fließend Englisch. raw.title: Paid Marketing Manager (m/w/d) - Germany
raw.description:
Pennylane ist ein französisches Fintech, das 2020 gegründet wurde und seinen Hauptsitz in Paris hat. Wir entwickeln ein Finanzbetriebssystem für europäische KMU und ihre Steuerkanzleien, bei dem KI von Anfang an mitgedacht ist. Unsere Plattform vereint Buchhaltung, Rechnungsstellung, Ausgabenmanagement und Business Banking. Unternehmen und Steuerkanzleien arbeiten damit auf einer gemeinsamen Datenbasis – in Echtzeit.

  • 1.200 Mitarbeiter und ein Team, das schnell wächst.

  • Über 1,5 Millionen Unternehmen und 6.000 Steuerkanzleien auf der Plattform.

  • 200 Mio. Euro jährlich wiederkehrender Umsatz (ARR) im Jahr 2025 – rund doppelt so viel wie im Vorjahr.

  • 175 Mio. Euro Finanzierung im Januar 2026 bei einer Bewertung von 3,5 Mrd. Euro. Zu unseren Investoren zählen TCV, Blackstone, Sequoia, DST Global, CapitalG und Meritech.

  • Expansion in Europa: Seit Ende 2025 sind wir in Deutschland aktiv. Die Einführung der E-Rechnung gibt der Digitalisierung des Finanzwesens zusätzlichen Rückenwind.

Deutschland ist ein zentraler Baustein unserer europäischen Expansion. Mit dieser Rolle gestaltest du den Erfolg direkt mit.

Warum wir dich suchen

Paid Marketing ist einer unserer schnellsten Hebel, um in Deutschland qualifizierte Nachfrage aufzubauen. Bisher fehlt uns dafür eine Person, die den deutschen Markt eigenständig verantwortet und unser Wachstum bei Vertriebspipeline und monatlich wiederkehrendem Umsatz (MRR) gezielt vorantreibt.

Als Paid Marketing Manager Germany übernimmst du unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise von der Strategie bis zur Optimierung. Du machst aus Werbebudget qualifizierte Leads und behältst dabei die Kundenakquisekosten im Blick.

Deine Mission

Du baust unsere bezahlte Kundenakquise für Deutschland aus und skalierst sie über SEA, Paid Social, Display und – wo sinnvoll – Affiliate-Marketing. Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Leads zu unseren angestrebten CAC- und CPA-Werten sowie ein starker Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Dafür entwickelst du Kampagnen und Landingpages, die deutsche KMU und Steuerkanzleien gezielt ansprechen.

Dein Team und Umfeld

Du wirst Teil unseres Growth-Teams und arbeitest in der Demand-Generation-Squad. Du berichtest direkt an Hervé Gaborieau, Demand Generation Manager.

Für den deutschen Markt liegt Paid Acquisition vollständig in deiner Hand: Strategie, Budget, Umsetzung und Performance. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren internationalen und lokalen Teams zusammen:

  • Paid-Team in Frankreich: Du nutzt bestehende Playbooks, Kampagnenstrukturen und Erkenntnisse aus SEA und Affiliate-Marketing als Grundlage für den deutschen Markt.

  • Growth Engineering und Data: Gemeinsam sorgt ihr für zuverlässiges Tracking, aussagekräftige Attribution, Dashboards und fundierte Performance-Analysen.

  • Website-Team: Ihr stimmt Paid-Landingpages auf die Kampagnen ab und verbessert gemeinsam die Conversion.

  • Brand & Design, Content und Product Marketing: Zusammen entwickelt ihr Creatives und Botschaften, die im deutschen Markt überzeugen.

  • GTM- und Sales-Team Deutschland: Ihr stimmt Lead-Volumen und Lead-Qualität aufeinander ab und nutzt das Feedback aus dem Vertrieb zur laufenden Optimierung.

Deine Aufgaben

1. Paid-Strategie entwickeln und Kampagnen umsetzen

  • Du verantwortest den deutschen Kanal-Mix: Google Ads mit Search, Display und Performance Max, Paid Social auf LinkedIn und Meta sowie bei Bedarf Affiliate-Marketing.

  • Du entwickelst, startest und optimierst Kampagnen – von Targeting, Gebotsstrategien und Zielgruppen über Keywords bis zu Creatives.

  • Du passt Kampagnen und Botschaften an den deutschen Markt und die Bedürfnisse unserer Zielgruppen an.

2. Budget und Performance steuern

  • Du verantwortest das deutsche Paid-Budget, verteilst es auf die passenden Kanäle und optimierst die Effizienz anhand unserer CAC-, CPA- und ROAS-Ziele.

  • Du steigerst das Volumen qualifizierter Leads und stellst gemeinsam mit dem deutschen Sales-Team sicher, dass die Qualität stimmt.

  • Du berichtest Ergebnisse und Erkenntnisse an das Growth-Leadership-Team und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte ab.

  • Gemeinsam mit Growth Engineering und Data entwickelst du Tracking, Attribution und Dashboards weiter.

  • Erfahrung im Performance Marketing: Du hast 3–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Paid- oder Performance-Marketing, idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Offenheit für KI: Du setzt KI selbstverständlich als Unterstützung in deiner Arbeit ein – idealerweise bereits im Paid Marketing.

raw.title: Growth Product Manager - Website & Conversion
raw.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Growth Product Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

 

If you’re excited about this role and think you could make an impact, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every requirement.

We are currently operating approximately 30k business accounts under a BaaS model with Swan. The role of Financial Services in our strategy is set to grow, both in terms of revenue and product contribution, to serve our 800k current customer base. As such, we are initiating a process to get licensed as Etablissement de paiement et Société de financement. Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers by mid 2027 before starting migrating existing customers. We are looking for a Lead Legal Counsel to drive the legal function of our Financial Services activity and build our regulatory legal team. After licensing, you will shift from “building the file” to running and scaling the legal function of the regulated entity: ensuring ongoing compliance with ACPR expectations, enabling product growth safely, and keeping the operating model (including outsourcing) continuously audit-ready. You will own the legal oversight of day-to-day legal and corporate matters (policies, governance, reporting support, inspections), lead the legal work for launching new regulated products and entering new partnerships, and manage the legal aspects of onboarding and migrating customers to the licensed subsidiary (terms, communications, complaints/conduct risk). Organisation & Reporting You will be part of the core Legal Department. Your reporting line will be Stanislas, our General Counsel. You will also partner closely with our Financial Services Chief Compliance and Risk Officer, Chief Operational Officer and the contract team. Mission & Objectives Team Leadership & Structuring You manage, mentor, and develop your team member(s), fostering a high-performance, autonomous, and pragmatic legal culture. You anticipate future hiring needs and actively participate in scaling the regulatory legal team. Corporate and governance You design, document and run the legal aspects of corporate governance: delegation of powers, board/committee charters, conflicts management, inter-company arrangements on payment services outsourcing, governance narrative for the ACPR reports, and ongoing legal compliance cadence once authorized. Products, contracts and customer legal architecture You own the legal design of the FS product perimeter (payments services, account services, credit/financing products as applicable). You work with the contractual team (Roland) on the associated contractual framework: customer terms, disclosures, pricing documentation, complaint handling language, and operational/legal flows (including KYC/AML handoffs, incident handling and customer communications). Outsourcing / BaaS transition & vendor contracting You own legal matters relating to critical outsourcing and third-party reliance (including existing BaaS arrangements): contract negotiation, regulatory outsourcing clauses, audit/access rights, sub-outsourcing controls, exit plans, SLAs, data protection allocation, operational resilience expectations, and documentation suitable for ACPR scrutiny. Migration readiness In close collaboration with the operation team (Maxime), you lead the legal plan for migrating customers from Swan (sequencing, consent/novation approaches, customer communications from a legal standpoint, continuity of mandates, handling of incidents/complaints, and safeguards to minimise conduct risk). Privacy and Security In close coordination with our DPO (Léa) and security stakeholders, you ensure that our Financial Services operating model address data processing roles, cross-border flows (if any), retention, incident response, recordkeeping, and contractual protections with key providers. Regulatory engagement support & internal enablement Until we are fully licenced, you help prepare ACPR interactions (Q&A packs, position papers, meeting preparation). Once authorized, you own the relationship with ACPR from a legal perspective, supporting the CCRO with legal opinions, advisory etc. You train internal stakeholders on the legal/regulatory constraints that shape product and operations, and build a “legal-by-design” approach for Financial Services. Culture, Training & Advisory You will be expected to operate as an owner, not a “support function,” and to produce pragmatic, regulator-ready outcomes. About you You have 8+ years of relevant experience, including in-house legal experience at a regulated entity (payments, EMI/PI, bank, lending/consumer credit, factoring, etc.), fintech, or BaaS. You have a proven track record or a strong aptitude for managing, mentoring, and developing team members in a fast-paced environment. You have substantial experience in regulated financial services legal work, and you are comfortable owning cross-functional programmes. Senior legal expert in a French ACPR-regulated entity (établissement de paiement, établissement de crédit, société de financement or similar). Hands on contract experience and knowledge about our regulatory environment (arrêté du 3 novembre 2014, PSD2, DORA, EBA Guidelines, etc). Skills & mindset Technical strengths You can credibly lead on : ACPR/European regulatory frameworks for payments and/or lending/financing; Outsourcing and third-party risk legal frameworks in regulated environments; Governance and regulated-entity corporate law basics. Soft skills Player-coach mentality: capable of executing complex individual contributions while guiding and empowering your team. You can work fast without losing rigour. Strong pedagogy: able to explain complex regulatory legal topics to product managers, engineers and founders in simple, actionable terms. Pragmatic, impact-driven approach, capable of operating under strong regulatory constraints without blocking innovation. Very strong written and oral communication skills in both French and English. Languages, presence and location Fluent French and English are mandatory. Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris. Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. title: Quantum Software Engineer
description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include a very energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Description of the Project We are looking for a Quantum Software Engineer to develop the future software stack for controlling utility-scale quantum computers. At the interface of the theory and engineering teams, this ambitious project aims to develop internal tools to streamline the operation of logical quantum circuits on Quandela’s spin-photonic quantum computers. This position requires a strong understanding of quantum computing protocols on real hardware, strong software engineering skills and proficiency with AI tools. Your Key Responsibilities: Develop a new compilation stack translating high-level quantum circuits into hardware-aware pulse schedules optimized for our photonic quantum computers. Drive long-term architectural strategy, technical roadmap, and cross-organizational alignment. Contribute to the development of a digital twin, receiving hardware instructions to simulate the behavior of our future QPUs. Stay up to date with the latest developments in quantum software. How You’ll Grow: 3 months. By the end of the first quarter, you are expected to have a grasp over Quandela’s roadmap and specific approach to quantum computing. You understand how user operations are currently compiled to machine instructions and how that is expected to evolve 6 months. By the end of the first semester, you have a firm understanding of Quandela’s technology and are already a key contributor to the compiler codebase for the near future 12 months. You have a long-term vision over the quantum software’s activities, and are the owner of one or more work packages for strategic projects. Requirements What we're looking for: Master’s, or PhD in Quantum related field. 2/4+ years of relevant experience in quantum software, quantum hardware automation, or related topics. Must-have: A good understanding of photonic-based quantum computing. Strong proficiency in python. Experience working at the interface of software, experimental hardware, and theory teams in the industry or academia. Collaborative mindset, able to serve as a bridge between various teams. Important, but you can grow here: Proficiency in at least one system language (C++ or Rust) Exposure to the quantum computing frontends and related ecosystem (e.g. cirq, qiskit, openqasm, cuda-q). Hands-on experience with quantum photonic systems. Familiarity with compilation mechanisms such as LLVM or compilation to microcode. Benefits Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience Profit-sharing & company savings plan 100% health coverage (Alan) 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000) What we offer: A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one A team eager to collaborate and grow with you A hybrid work model (3-4 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris or 1 to 2 days remotely) Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between. title: Lead AI engineer
description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

 

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You’ll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders
  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components
  • Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics

  • Business impact delivered by AI initiatives
  • Adoption within the domain
  • Technical quality and reliability
  • Team capability growth

 

Our stack and tools

  • Languages: Python and SQL
  • AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models
  • Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases
  • Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

 

You'll Love This Job If you have 

  • 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI
  • Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems
  • Ability to influence Product and Business decisions
  • Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

  • A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.
  • An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.
  • 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.
