title: Data Scientist
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About The Role 

We are seeking a versatile Data Scientist to join the Functional Analytics team. The core mission of our team is to design and develop new functional analytic capabilities or “engines” that integrate directly into Anaplan Applications to solve complex enterprise business problems. 

In this role, you will develop best-in-class ML models and pipelines to drive automated, actionable insights at scale. Beyond core development, you will act as a key technical partner for our customers. You will play a highly visible role in driving customer onboardings, getting hands-on with client data to customize and fine-tune our ML engines so they seamlessly adapt to complex business realities and specific customer needs. 

Your Impact 

  • Customer Onboarding & Engine Customization: Lead the technical deployment of our engines for new clients. Partner closely with customers, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to adapt and customize ML models, ensuring they accurately reflect client-specific business logic, operational guardrails, and unique data nuances.
  • Analytic Engine Development: Design and develop scalable functional analytic capabilities that seamlessly integrate into Anaplan Applications, translating raw customer data into automated, high-value business insights.
  • Advanced Modeling & Timeseries Forecasting: Design, train, and implement robust Machine Learning (LightGBM, XGBoost) and Deep Learning (PyTorch) models specifically focused on complex demand sensing and resolving cold-start forecasting problems.
  • Feature Engineering Pipelines: Build and optimize scalable data pipelines leveraging a hybrid SQL/Python architecture (dbt, Snowflake) to extract rich, localized temporal signals from high-volume transactional retail data.
  • End-to-End Deployment (MLOps): Partner with our engineers to transition your models from prototype into scalable, monitored, and reliable production pipelines using tools like MLflow and Optuna. 

Your Skills 

  • Strong hands-on professional experience in Data Science, successfully building and deploying systems from prototype to production in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong predictive modeling foundation: Extensive experience with traditional ML algorithms, Deep Learning frameworks, and complex time-series forecasting.
  • Experience developing production-grade Python code: High proficiency in Python, Pandas, and modern software practices (testing, clean code, code review, CI/CD).
  • Data & Pipeline Expertise: Hands-on experience optimizing data models and access patterns for modern data warehouses (Snowflake, Databricks) utilizing SQL and transformation tools like dbt.
  • Cloud & Data Infrastructure: Experience working with scalable cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and handling columnar data formats like Parquet.
  • MLOps Exposure: Experience with tools and frameworks for training, tracking, deploying, and monitoring models in production (e.g., MLflow, Optuna, Prefect, or Airflow). 

Desirable 

  • Background in supply chain forecasting, enterprise AI, or retail analytics
  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.  
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.  

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

In this role, you’ll be a senior technical advisor to city governments across North, Central and South America, working in both an advisory and a hands-on capacity to help them design, build and launch small scale pilots of new services for residents.

Working alongside experienced product managers, data scientists, AI engineers, and designers, you’ll help multidisciplinary city teams build in-house product development capability by prototyping and delivering digital products and services, many of which harness data and AI.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description: This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands at saas.group . Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within the saas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike. Profile Overview Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find. To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter. This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way. You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources from saas.group 's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you. So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries. We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies. Your responsibilities Technology Vision and Strategy: Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value. Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces. Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend. Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting. Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market. Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability. Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team. Security and Compliance: Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible. Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure. Team Management and Growth: Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here. Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them. Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization. Execution and Delivery: Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence. Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems. Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows. Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands. Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management: Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board. Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs. Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth. Ownership & Autonomy: Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships. Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made. Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement. What You bring to the table 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company. Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned. Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity , with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume. Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation. A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick. A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed. Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility. Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else. Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus. Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing. What’s in it for You Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like. Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it. Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings. Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product. Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously. Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise. Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to. Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources. Prerender is part of saas.group , and we have a shared goal of succeeding together. What is saas.group ? Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work. Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company. We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient! — saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

  • Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
  • Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
  • Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
  • Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.

Security and Compliance:

  • Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
  • Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.

Team Management and Growth:

  • Coach and mentor engineers to reach their full potential. Set clear expectations and create opportunities for growth. People matter here.
  • Build a culture of ownership, where engineers carry their decisions through instead of escalating them.
  • Foster diversity and inclusion within the engineering organization.

Execution and Delivery:

  • Own the continuous improvement motion of delivery. The team finds and removes its own bottlenecks on a regular cadence.
  • Enhance DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and robust monitoring systems.
  • Define and track engineering metrics that matter. Use data to identify bottlenecks and optimize workflows.
  • Manage change deliberately. Changes to practice, process and infrastructure reach the people who have to run them — and, where customers are affected, the customers — with notice, consultation, and a route to raise a question before the change lands.

Executive Partnership and Stakeholder Management:

  • Partner with the CEO and leadership team on company strategy. Communicate technology progress to company leadership and the board.
  • Work closely with Product to align engineering capacity with customer needs.
  • Translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and advocate for investments that drive business growth.

Ownership & Autonomy:

  • Own the full R&D budget including personnel, infrastructure, tooling, and vendor relationships.
  • Run that budget as a managed number. Maintain an infrastructure cost model, report forecast against actual, and be able to say what a decision costs before it's made.
  • Make the right decisions for engineering, aligned with company strategy, without second-guessing or micromanagement.

What You bring to the table

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership (VP/Director/CTO) at a SaaS company.
  • Strong infrastructure background with experience running large-scale distributed systems and production Kubernetes, and making strategic tradeoffs between cost, maintenance burden, and engineering velocity. You've driven unit costs down on a fleet you owned.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed AI tooling into engineering workflows and multiply team productivity, with a clear-eyed view of where it helps, where it produces plausible work that doesn't hold up, and how review standards survive the increase in volume.
  • Proven experience coaching, mentoring, and developing engineering teams, ideally through a significant transformation.
  • A track record of raising a team's delivery speed and keeping it raised long after the initial push, with the measurement and process change that made it stick.
  • A record of landing process and platform change that sticks, with the people affected brought along before it landed.
  • Experience owning a security and compliance program in a SaaS company — SOC 2, ISO 27001 or equivalent — as a continuing operational responsibility.
  • Business-oriented and hands-on: you understand how engineering decisions connect to revenue and customer value, and you contribute directly alongside the team, through the same review and planning process as everyone else.
  • Experience with scalable, high-performance web products, CI/CD, DevOps, and security principles. SEO or search-related experience is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills. Comfortable presenting to boards, working with executives, and collaborating cross-functionally. Communication is async-first in our remote environment, leaning on clear, timely updates with documentation up-to-date and readable and proactive context-sharing.

What’s in it for You

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. Work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: High-trust environment with lots of independence to solve problems your way, with support when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We stay efficient and keep momentum sustainable. No death by meetings.
  • Real impact: This is a C-level role with a seat at the executive table, board visibility, and the mandate to transform how we build product.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and don't take ourselves too seriously.
  • Our network: Access to a community of SaaS professionals across the saas.group portfolio who regularly exchange ideas and expertise.
  • Flexible time off: Recharge when you need to.
  • Learning Budget: Generous budget for classes, conferences, books, and other learning resources.

Prerender is part of saas.group, and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

—

saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

Our systems operate at a scale unseen outside of the largest Internet companies -- processing over 12 million requests per second and interacting with over 5 billion unique users each day. The Serving team builds and maintains the mission-critical infrastructure responsible for serving ads across Liftoff’s product line. Design and operate large feature store fleets that provide low-latency access to real-time and precomputed features. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience. The following are our base salary ranges for this role: SF Bay Area, NYC, Los Angeles/Orange County : $255,000 - $310,000 Seattle/Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $234,000 - $285,000 All other cities and towns in our approved states: $219,000 - $266,000 #LI-EL1 Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence. Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Agency and Third Party Recruiter Notice: Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. title: Senior Backend Engineer II, AI Native, Vertical Experiences
description: About Life360 Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries. Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family). Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com. Life360 is a Remote-First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above. We are AI Native We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process. Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy. About The Team The Vertical Experiences team builds the experiences that bring pets into the family — pet profiles, activity timelines, care coordination, lost pet alerts, and third-party integrations. We sit within Life360's Devices org, but our work is squarely in the consumer product layer: building experiences that help families care for, track, and stay connected to their pets. We ship frequently, own our features end to end, and work closely with mobile, design, and product to define what pet ownership looks like inside Life360. We are an AI-Native team. AI isn't an add-on to how we work — it's how we work. We've redesigned our development workflows around AI, using it as a first-class collaborator at every stage: spec writing, code generation, test authoring, incident triage, and system design. We ship faster and go deeper because of it. We're looking for engineers who want to help define what AI-native development looks like for a high-traffic consumer product. About the Job As a Backend Engineer on the Vertical Experiences (Devices Cloud) team, you’ll build and operate the cloud services that power Life360’s connected devices. This role sits at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and mobile, translating real-world device signals into reliable, scalable backend systems. You’ll work on high-throughput, low-latency services that manage device state, ingest telemetry, and enable new device-driven features for millions of members worldwide. The work is hands-on, systems-oriented, and designed for engineers who enjoy solving messy, real-world problems at scale. You don't just use AI tools. You think natively in them. Your primary workflow involves orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and perform reviews. You'll help establish and evolve AI-native engineering practices for the Vertical Experiences team while delivering features that ship to production weekly. For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $148,000 to $216,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $171,500 to $201,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers. Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) , as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain backend services that support device connectivity, telemetry ingest, health monitoring, and command/control operations. Collaborate with firmware, mobile, and product teams to define APIs and workflows for device features. Deliver scalable, resilient systems in a microservices environment running on AWS (EKS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, etc.). Build and own data pipelines for high-throughput streams using Kafka or similar streaming tech. Instrument services for observability, reliability, and SLO compliance. Participate in on-call rotations and live incident response. Write clean, testable, performant code and help improve CI/CD and automation. Orchestrate AI coding agents daily for spec writing, code generation, test authoring, incident triage, PR review, and system design What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s in Computer Science or equivalent experience. 5+ years experience building backend services in Java, Go, Python, or similar languages. Experience with microservices architecture, RESTful API design, and distributed systems. Strong skills with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), container orchestration, and deployments. Experience with databases (relational and/or NoSQL), caching layers, and event/streaming systems. Comfortable collaborating across teams and articulating technical tradeoffs. Hands-on agentic AI workflow experience. Nice-to-Have Experience with IoT or telematics systems. Familiarity with Kafka, Kinesis, or other streaming platforms. Experience with high-frequency ingest systems and time-series data. A background with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Knowledge of SRE practices and automated testing frameworks. AI-Native Expectations We use AI coding tools as a professional standard on this team. Here's what that means in practice: Daily use: You use AI coding assistants (we support Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for real, substantive tasks: analysis, coding, refactoring, testing, navigating codebases, and documentation. Not just research or autocomplete. Judgment and ownership: AI-generated code gets the same review you'd give any PR. You are accountable for everything you ship. Velocity: We expect senior engineers who use AI well to operate with meaningful leverage — doing more with the same time, taking on problems that would otherwise require a larger team. Team leadership: You share what works. You automate prompting strategies that others can build on. Continuous learning: The tooling is changing fast. You stay current and bring recommendations to the team. Our Benefits Competitive pay and benefits. Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees. Paid parental leave. 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees. Mental Wellness Program & EAP. Flexible PTO and 12 company-wide days off throughout the year. Learning & Development programs. Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment. Free Life360 Platinum Membership for your preferred circle. Free Tile Products. Life360 Values Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference. Be a Good Person — We have a team of high integrity people you can trust. Be Direct With Respect — We communicate directly, even when it’s hard. Members Before Metrics — We focus on building an exceptional experience for families. High Intensity, High Impact — We do whatever it takes to get the job done. Our Commitment to Diversity We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status. We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying! #LI-Remote

We work with device manufacturers across the energy hardware ecosystem - from EV brands to heat pump and solar inverter producers. Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum. title: AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Product Concept Designer & Interior Stylist – Home Décor (Part-/Full-time) based in Switzerland. In this fully remote role, you will combine creative vision, interior design expertise, and advanced AI image-generation skills to develop distinctive, commercially promising home décor products. You will transform emerging design trends and customer preferences into original product concepts and compelling visual experiences. A key part of your work will involve creating photorealistic interior scenes that showcase products with accurate materials, textures, colors, and proportions. You will collaborate with designers to refine concepts and prepare product visuals for e-commerce launches. By balancing aesthetics with commercial potential, you will help shape an attractive product portfolio for a premium home décor brand serving online customers. This long-term freelance opportunity offers the flexibility to work part-time or full-time while contributing directly to product innovation and digital merchandising. It is ideal for a visually driven creative professional who understands how to turn inspiring design ideas into products customers want to buy. Accountabilities Product concept development: Research interior design trends, competitor offerings, and customer preferences to identify new home décor opportunities and develop original, commercially viable product concepts. AI-powered concept visualization: Use advanced generative AI tools to explore, visualize, and refine new physical product ideas, translating creative concepts into compelling visual representations. Interior styling and scene creation: Place existing and proposed products into realistic, aesthetically cohesive AI-generated interiors that reflect different design styles, including Japandi, organic modern, and coastal interiors. Photorealistic product imagery: Produce high-quality lifestyle and product visuals for e-commerce websites, ensuring generated images accurately represent the original products' shapes, proportions, materials, colors, and textures. Visual quality and consistency: Maintain high standards of realism, composition, lighting, and styling across all creative outputs, ensuring that product details remain faithful to the intended designs. Trend research and opportunity identification: Monitor emerging interior styles, materials, product categories, and customer preferences to uncover opportunities for new product development and commercial growth. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with designers and relevant team members to refine concepts, incorporate feedback, and prepare product designs and visual assets for launch. Commercial evaluation: Assess the market appeal and potential sales value of proposed products, balancing aesthetic originality with customer demand and commercial objectives. E-commerce content development: Create visually engaging product and lifestyle imagery that strengthens online merchandising, communicates product value, and supports customer purchasing decisions. Creative workflow management: Organize multiple projects, manage deadlines, maintain clear communication, and deliver consistent, high-quality outputs in a fully remote working environment. Product feasibility awareness: Consider practical manufacturing requirements, material limitations, production constraints, and shipping considerations when developing physical product concepts. Requirements Visual design and aesthetic expertise: Excellent visual taste and a strong understanding of interior design, styling, color theory, materials, textures, proportions, and composition. Advanced AI image-generation skills: Demonstrated proficiency with generative AI tools such as Nano Banana, Flux, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or comparable platforms. Photorealistic image creation: Proven ability to generate convincing interior scenes and product imagery while preserving accurate product characteristics, including shape, material, color, texture, and proportions. Creative concept development: Strong imagination and the ability to translate market insights, design inspiration, and customer preferences into original, visually appealing, and commercially promising physical products. You will hold the vehicle in your head as a complete system and take responsibility for ensuring that what we design can actually work, integrate, be tested and ultimately fly. This is not a role for someone who wants to govern engineering from a distance. You will work directly with exceptional engineers, get deep into difficult technical problems and make consequential decisions with incomplete information. You will challenge assumptions, resolve conflicts between disciplines and keep the overall architecture coherent as the vehicle evolves at pace. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. You may have grown through Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle design or another deeply technical discipline. What matters is that you have developed the breadth, judgement and technical credibility to make decisions at whole-vehicle level. If you have spent your career building systems that people initially thought were too difficult, too ambitious or too fast to deliver, we want to hear from you. What you'll do Own the technical integrity of Hypersonica’s flight vehicles from system concept through design, integration, test and flight. Define and continuously evolve the overall vehicle architecture, ensuring that mission objectives translate into a coherent physical and functional system. Act as the senior technical authority across vehicle-level engineering decisions, trade-offs, interfaces and risk. Ensure GNC, avionics, electronics, software, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, thermal systems, power and payloads work together as a single integrated vehicle. Drive the definition and decomposition of mission and system requirements, focusing on the requirements that genuinely determine whether the vehicle succeeds. Own the critical interfaces between systems and resolve technical conflicts when optimisation within one discipline damages performance somewhere else. Lead major system-level trades around performance, mass, power, thermal constraints, controllability, reliability, manufacturability and operational capability. Work closely with GNC and avionics teams to ensure sensing, estimation, control, computing, actuation and vehicle dynamics form a robust closed-loop system. Challenge designs from first principles rather than accepting assumptions because they are conventional or inherited from previous programmes. Lead technical readiness for major design reviews, integration milestones and flight tests. Use test and flight data aggressively, turning unexpected behaviour and failures into design improvements rather than paperwork. Work directly with Manufacturing and AIT to make sure the vehicle being designed can actually be built, integrated, tested and iterated quickly. Make difficult technical decisions when information is incomplete, balancing engineering rigour with the speed required to deliver breakthrough capability. Who you are An exceptional multidisciplinary engineer who naturally thinks at system and vehicle level rather than only within a single subsystem. Deeply technically credible, with a strong foundation in areas such as Systems Engineering, GNC, avionics, flight controls, vehicle architecture or complex aerospace system design. Experienced taking complex aerospace, defence, space, autonomous or similarly high-consequence systems from concept into real integrated hardware. Strong in system architecture, requirements, interfaces, integration, verification and technical risk. Comfortable reasoning about closed-loop vehicle behaviour, including the relationship between vehicle dynamics, sensors, estimation, control, actuators and onboard computing. Able to understand a difficult technical problem quickly, identify the assumptions that actually matter and drive the team towards an answer. Experienced making significant engineering trade-offs across multiple disciplines rather than optimising one component in isolation. Comfortable moving between first-principles technical discussion and major programme-level decisions without losing depth. Willing to get personally involved when a problem matters. You do not need a large team, perfect information or an established process before you can make progress. Able to distinguish engineering rigour from engineering bureaucracy. Confident challenging exceptional specialists in their own disciplines while remaining open enough to change your own mind when the evidence demands it. Calm when things go wrong, intellectually honest when something is not understood and relentless about finding the real answer. Motivated by the opportunity to build sovereign European defence capability and comfortable working on systems where the consequences of engineering decisions genuinely matter. You might have come from There is no single route to becoming the right Chief Engineer for Hypersonica. You may currently be a Chief Engineer, Systems Architect, Head of Systems Engineering, GNC Lead, Avionics Lead, Flight Controls Lead, Vehicle Architect or Principal Engineer . You may have spent your career in missiles, high-speed flight, combat aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous systems or another environment where complex physical systems need to work first time. We are less interested in your current title than in the scale of the technical problems you have personally solved. What we offer The opportunity to hold genuine technical ownership of one of Europe’s most ambitious defence engineering programmes. A company early enough that your decisions will materially shape the vehicles, engineering organisation and technical culture we build. Direct access to the problem. Short decision paths, minimal bureaucracy and engineers empowered to solve engineering problems. Daily collaboration with exceptional people across GNC, avionics, propulsion, aerodynamics, structures, manufacturing, test and defence. The freedom to challenge convention, build from first principles and move quickly when the evidence supports it. The resources and ambition to attempt things that would take significantly longer in traditional aerospace organisations. The opportunity to see your decisions move from a whiteboard, into hardware and ultimately into flight. The person we are looking for We are not looking for someone to simply approve other people’s engineering. We are looking for the person engineers turn to when the disciplines disagree, the data is incomplete, the deadline is real and somebody has to understand the whole system well enough to make the call. title: Technical SAP Enterprise Architect (w/m/d)
description: Als Technical Enterprise Architect bei Westernacher sind Sie strategischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden bei der Planung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller SAP‑S/4HANA‑Transformationen. Sie verbinden architektonische Exzellenz mit methodischem Vorgehen und unterstützen Entscheidungsprozesse auf Managementebene. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT‑Teams und Presales gestalten Sie nachhaltige, skalierbare Zielarchitekturen und sorgen für eine klare Ausrichtung von Technologie, Prozessen und Organisation. Ihre Aufgaben Konzeption und Definition von S/4HANA‑Zielarchitekturen (On‑Premises, Private Cloud, RISE with SAP) sowie Ableitung klarer Migrations- und Transformations-Roadmaps. Bewertung und Steuerung von S/4HANA‑Migrationsszenarien (Brownfield, Selective, Greenfield) inklusive Risiko-, Aufwands- und Entscheidungsanalysen. Durchführung von System-Readiness-Analysen und technischen Prechecks mithilfe von SAP‑Standardtools (z. B. Readiness Check, Business Transformation Center, Maintenance Planner). Analyse von Simplification Items und Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen für Prozesse, Organisation und Customizing. Verantwortung für Custom‑Code‑Management, inklusive Analyse, Stilllegung und Refactoring im Sinne der Clean-Core-Prinzipien. Design und Governance von Integrations- und Schnittstellenarchitekturen (RFC, IDoc, APIs, OData, Webservices) gemäß SAP ISA‑M. Sicherstellung der Kompatibilität mit Drittanbieter‑Add-ons und Legacy-Systemen. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen, IT, Key‑Usern sowie Vertrieb/Presales. Erstellung und Präsentation von Entscheidungsvorlagen, Management-Briefings sowie Risiko- und Impact-Analysen. Architektonischer Input zu Governance, Security, Change Management, Tests, Schulungen und Post-Go-Live-Aktivitäten. Ihr Profil Fundierte Expertise in SAP S/4HANA-Architektur, einschließlich Datenmodelle, Unterschiede ECC vs. S/4HANA, Fiori-Konzepte sowie End-to-End-Prozessverständnis. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in S/4HANA-Transformationen, einschließlich Migrationsansätzen, Readiness-Bewertungen, Vorprojekten (z. B. CVI, Universal Journal, Material Ledger, Anlagenbuchhaltung) und technischen Voraussetzungen. Starke Kenntnisse in Custom Code und Integrationsarchitektur, einschließlich ATC/SCI, APIs, Schnittstellen, Clean-Core-Ansatz und ISA-M. Sicherer Umgang mit relevanten SAP-Tools und Plattformen für Conversion und Modernisierung (z. B. Readiness Check, SUM/DMO, Fiori, LeanIX, Signavio; SAP Cloud ALM/Solution Manager von Vorteil). Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in SAP-Projekten, einschließlich mindestens einer S/4HANA-Conversion, sowie tiefes Know-how in mindestens zwei Kernprozessen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten auf Fach- und Managementebene. Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Das bieten wir Abwechslungsreiches und vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einem 100% Mitarbeiterunternehmen Die Möglichkeit an unserem Partnerschaftsmodell teilzunehmen Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation und ein internationales ambitioniertes Team aus erfahrenen SAP-Experten mit starkem Innovations- und Teamgeist Förderung Deiner Weiterentwicklung durch systematische Fortbildungen und Know-how-Austausch Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office und attraktive Vergütung Seit 1969 steht Westernacher Consulting für Innovation und globale Präsenz. Mit einem Team von über 1400 Beratern in Europa, Asien und Amerika bieten wir weltweit SAP-Beratungsdienstleistungen an. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Unterstützung von Groß- und Mittelstandsunternehmen, die nach Innovation, operativer Exzellenz und nachhaltigem Wachstum streben. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Heidelberg, sind wir Vorreiter in der Innovation von Geschäftsprozessen und Technologien. Westernacher schätzt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit am Arbeitsplatz. raw.description:
Your mission

Our Engineering team

Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between infrastructure, backend, and frontend.

We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership, and team spirit.

👉 Curious to see what we’re building? Check out our Tech Blog!

As a Data Scientist Intern, you will help us push the boundaries of what AI can do inside Pigment, focusing on how our AI Modeler builds and maintains planning models. You’ll work closely with our AI engineering and data science teams to design, test, and evaluate LLM-based systems that turn loosely structured inputs into reliable, working Pigment models and formulas.

Project Overview: Making Pigment’s AI Modeler Smarter

Depending on your profile and interests, you will focus on one of these topics:

1. Formula Writing from Specifications

Have the Modeler write a specification of a formula (what it should do, and the tests it must pass), then build a small Formula Writer model that produces a correct formula from it.

2. Building Models from External Documents

Turn amorphous inputs (long PDFs, call transcripts, existing applications, templates) into structured Pigment applications: write the tests first, then iterate on a DSL representation until they pass.

3. Building Models from Databases

Given an existing database, determine which blocks and transformations to create to make sense of the data and integrate it as a Pigment model.

As an intern, you will:

  • Define success criteria, test suites, and evaluation metrics for your topic.
  • Design and iterate on LLM-based approaches (prompting, agentic workflows, intermediate representations).
  • Benchmark quality, reliability, and cost/latency, and document trade-offs.
  • Work with engineers and data scientists to build evaluation pipelines and share findings.

    • Technical Stack

    Our current AI and engineering stack includes:

  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, LangGraph
  • Data & ML Infrastructure: Weights & Biases, Hugging Face Hub, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes
  • Databases: PostgreSQL
  • CI/CD & Experimentation: CircleCI, MLflow, and internal orchestration tools

    • We don’t expect you to know them all. What matters most is your ability to learn quickly, experiment rigorously, and translate data insights into actionable results.

    Work Environment

  • Hybrid: possibility to work partially remotely
  • Office in the heart of Paris (Paris 9)
  • Choose your working environment (hardware / OS)
  • A competitive remuneration package
  • Opportunity to continue your journey with us after your internship

  • Our current AI and engineering stack includes:
  • Languages & Frameworks: Python, LangGraph
  • Data & ML Infrastructure: Weights & Biases, Hugging Face Hub, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes

  • CI/CD & Experimentation: CircleCI, MLflow, and internal orchestration tools

title: Stage 3 Mois - 35H - Conseiller De Vente (H/F) - Montaigne
description: LA MAISON Jacquemus a été fondé par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l’art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l’appartement parisien d’Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d’ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street) et Dubai. VOTRE RÔLE En tant que Conseiller(ère) de vente, vous serez ambassadeur / ambassadrice de la Maison et vous jouerez un rôle essentiel afin d’offrir à chaque client une expérience unique dans le respect et l’engagement de la Maison Jacquemus. Vous vous efforcerez de découvrir la personnalité de vos clients et d'identifier leurs désirs, tout en leur faisant découvrir l’ADN de la Maison et tous les univers produits. VOS MISSIONS · Participer activement au développement du chiffre d’affaires en accompagnant l’équipe dans l’atteinte des objectifs du point de vente. · Accueillir et conseiller nos clients pour leur offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. · Découvrir et partager votre expertise sur nos produits auprès des clients. · Faire preuve de proactivité en suggérant des produits complémentaires. · Contribuer à la fidélisation de notre clientèle en développant des relations privilégiées. · Assurer la bonne tenue du point de vente en collaboration avec l’équipe. · Participer aux missions opérationnelles : Visual merchandising, réassort, gestion des stocks, SAV. · Appliquer et respecter les procédures internes et guidelines. · Représenter l’esprit Jacquemus à travers votre créativité et votre sens de l’excellence. PROFIL · Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, de mode ou de management, avec une forte sensibilité pour l’univers de la mode et du luxe. · Première expérience en vente ou relation client appréciée. · Excellentes capacités de communication et sens du service client. · Enthousiaste, curieux(se) et doté(e) d’un esprit d’initiative. · Adaptable et proactif(ve), avec un fort esprit d’équipe. · Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, une troisième langue serait un plus. title: AI-First Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description: Join Sport Alliance and help build the data platform behind Magicline and Finion, serving thousands of gyms and 10M+ members. You'll tackle real engineering challenges, from high-volume data modeling and cost-efficient warehousing to freshness trade-offs and financial data that has to be exactly right. We're building an AI-first data team. We use cutting-edge LLMs and internal tools to work faster, and we expect you to use and improve them. The platform you build powers our AI and analytics, making clean, reliable, well-modeled data essential. Whether you're an experienced engineer ready to own the platform or a strong mid-level engineer eager to grow into the role, we'd love to hear from you. Your position in our team Build and optimize cloud-native data pipelines on AWS — ETL/ELT and the infrastructure underneath (Aurora, Redshift, dbt, Spark/EMR, Airflow, CDC) — using AI tooling as a standard part of the workflow. Design and evolve the data models that power analytics, operational use cases, and AI/ML across thousands of studios. Help raise the bar on data reliability — embed governance, testing, and lineage so both people and AI systems can trust the numbers by default. Partner with product, and other engineering teams to turn ambiguous business problems into robust data solutions. Evaluate and evolve new approaches with us — data mesh patterns, and emerging AI tooling — and help decide what genuinely earns a place in our stack. Grow into our financial and regulatory reporting workstream (Finion Capital), where correctness and auditability matter most. Your profile 3+ years in data engineering with a focus on data warehousing — and the appetite to take on more ownership than you've held so far. Strong SQL and Python for data work. Working with AI tools feels natural to you — and, just as important, the judgment to review and validate what they produce. You treat AI output as a draft to verify, not an answer to trust, especially where correctness is non-negotiable. A solid grasp of data architecture and modeling principles (dimensional modeling, slowly-changing dimensions, incremental patterns) — or the drive to deepen it fast. Hands-on experience with dbt on a cloud warehouse — this is where you'll live day to day. Working knowledge of relational and some exposure to non-relational Databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB). A track record of debugging tricky data issues and shipping durable fixes. Excellent written and verbal English. Nice to have AWS experience (Redshift, EMR, Glue, S3, IAM); experience with GCP or Azure is also welcome. Streaming/CDC technologies (Kafka, Kinesis, Debezium) or data mesh. Experience building data pipelines for ML or AI systems. Exposure to financial, payments, or regulated reporting data. German (helpful for some stakeholder work, but not required). Your salary We offer a salary range of EUR 72,000 – EUR 82,000 per year. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, and overall fit for the role. description: About Us 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries. Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity. About the Team Our enterprise team serves internationally operating companies that want to simplify mobile connectivity across borders. Instead of many contracts with different network operators, they get one provider, one platform and consistent processes from 1GLOBAL, including eSIM, IoT connectivity and API integration. We work directly with customers and indirectly through resellers and distributors, in the DACH region and across our other markets. We are growing with our existing customers, through our partners and from new inbound requests. Many of these opportunities don't need a long enterprise sales cycle; they need fast and reliable closing. That is where you come in: you own this business independently, with your own targets and short paths into the team. You will be the first person in this role and shape it from day one. About the Role You win revenue with our existing customers, partners and new inbound requests: from identifying needs through quoting and negotiation to signature and activation. With your own sales targets, you own a clearly defined segment and work closely with our enterprise and partner teams in the DACH region and internationally. Grow existing customers You manage a portfolio of existing customers, spot additional needs (more countries, users, plans or IoT use cases) and turn them into upsell and cross-sell deals. You own contract renewals and expansions, from timely outreach through to signature. You are your customers' first point of contact in sales and resolve requests quickly, together with Customer Success or Support where needed. Qualify and close new opportunities You handle inbound requests, qualify them in a first call and close small and mid-sized deals yourself. You hand larger opportunities over to our enterprise sales team, well prepared, and support them through to closing. You use campaigns, events and referrals to start new conversations with companies in our focus segments. Activate partner revenue You support our resellers and distributors day to day: with quotes for their end customers, pricing questions and orders. You make sure new partners are up and running quickly and close their first deals. You identify which partners have more potential and agree next steps with Partner Management. From quote to activation You prepare quotes, negotiate terms within our pricing guidelines and take deals through to signature. You manage the path from order to activation, because revenue only starts once connections go live. You keep your pipeline and forecast up to date in our CRM so we always know where we stand. Requirements About You Must Have Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day Completed commercial apprenticeship or a degree, plus 1 to 4 years of B2B sales experience, for example in inside sales, account management, as an SDR/BDR or in sales support with direct customer contact Drive to close: you enjoy working towards targets and follow up until the deal is signed Fluent German and English, spoken and written: you negotiate and write in both languages every day Structure and reliability: you keep many deals and orders moving in parallel and see each one through Confident on the phone, by email and on video calls, with a friendly and solution-oriented tone Experience with CRM systems and confident with MS Office, especially Excel Nice to Have Experience in telecommunications or IT, for example with a network operator, service provider, system integrator or distributor Experience in indirect sales with resellers and distributors Experience with quoting and contract processes in an enterprise environment Additional languages, for example Dutch, Spanish, French, Polish or Portuguese Benefits Why 1GLOBAL? Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs. Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry. Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals. Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts. Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field. International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company. Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment. Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry. 1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (12 months FTC)
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As our organization continues to grow, attracting the best talent remains one of our highest priorities. To achieve this, it's essential to adapt by refining our recruitment strategies, upholding exceptional quality in our efforts, and embracing innovative recruitment methodologies. This is where our Talent Acquisition (TA) team plays a vital role.

In the role of Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will play a pivotal part in achieving the team's primary goal: attracting and hiring the right talent for Vinted while ensuring an outstanding candidate experience. Leveraging your expertise in recruitment, you will implement best hiring practices and collaborate with other team members on various projects. You’ll support either our Group & Marketplace business units, covering Community Support, Marketing, Finance, Legal and People, or our Vinted Pay & VintedGo business units, covering AML/Compliance, Business & Commercial and Logistics, with your focus shifting based on business needs.

If you're excited to contribute to our team's efforts in supporting our organization's growth, we would love to meet you.

Note. This role is offered as a 12-months fixed-term contract initially. There may be an opportunity for the position to be made permanent in the future, depending on business needs. 

In this position, you’ll 

  • Collaborate with hiring managers to understand hiring needs and ensure a seamless interview process to attract the right talent
  • Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including job posting, proactive candidate sourcing, conducting interviews, and extending offers
  • Build effective candidate talent pools through proactive sourcing, job boards, employee referrals, social media & employer branding campaigns etc
  • Guide hiring managers and interviewers on effective interview techniques and candidate evaluation methods
  • Track and report on key hiring metrics to ensure efficient recruitment processes, while providing a positive candidate and hiring manager experience
  • Gain exposure to talent acquisition initiatives by contributing to process improvement projects 
  • Stay informed about recruitment best practices and tools to continually improve the candidate experience

About you 

  • Previous experience as a Sourcer, Recruiter or Talent Acquisition Specialist specifically 
  • Proficiency in sourcing candidates using LinkedIn and other recruitment tools
  • Strong skills in candidate engagement and relationship building
  • Good understanding of assessment tools and interview evaluation techniques
  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to collaborate across teams and levels
  • A proactive mindset and eagerness to learn and grow within the talent acquisition field

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)
  • Frequent team-building events
  • Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
  • Lunch benefit per working day
  • Company bike leasing scheme
  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance 
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • NS Business Card for your commute to the office by public transport
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

The annual gross salary range for this position excluding 8% holiday pay is:
€47.300—€63.900 EUR

description: About Us Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. Practical experience building and operating production services, including observability and troubleshooting. Solid foundations in API design, networking, concurrency, and distributed systems with working knowledge of Kubernetes. Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with high-throughput messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or MQTT. About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We’re looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Senior Partner Manager (Strategic Partnerships) to build and scale Perk’s partner ecosystem across Europe, with a particular focus on the DACH region.

This is a commercial role with a clear objective: build partnerships that generate qualified sales pipeline and revenue for Perk. You’ll identify and recruit the right partners, develop joint go-to-market strategies, and turn those relationships into a repeatable growth channel. You’ll work closely with Sales and Marketing while owning partner relationships from initial outreach through launch, activation, and ongoing performance.

The ideal person combines a builder’s mindset with strong commercial instincts. You’re comfortable opening doors, creating something from scratch, and earning the trust of senior stakeholders. You’re ambitious, persistent, and focused on measurable results.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our partner ecosystem: Identify, recruit, and develop high-potential referral, reseller, technology, and strategic alliance partners across Europe, with a particular focus on DACH.

  • Generate pipeline and revenue: Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline targets, turning partnerships into a meaningful and repeatable growth channel for Perk.

  • Create joint go-to-market strategies: Build plans with priority partners across target accounts, campaigns, events, referrals, and co-selling motions.

  • Own the commercial relationship: Lead partner conversations from initial outreach through business case development, negotiation, contracting, launch, and ongoing growth.

  • Activate and enable partners: Give partners the product knowledge, sales materials, training, and support they need to confidently position Perk and identify opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Sales and Marketing: Ensure partner-generated opportunities are effectively routed, prioritised, and converted, while creating scalable ways for our commercial teams to work with partners.

  • Measure and improve performance: Set targets, forecast partner pipeline and revenue, identify what’s working, and continuously improve our partnership strategy and playbooks.

  • Bring new opportunities to Perk: Stay close to market and product developments and identify new partner models that can accelerate growth or create meaningful value for our customers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German and professional fluency in English.

  • Track record: Proven success in partnerships, alliances, channel sales, or business development, ideally within SaaS, fintech, travel technology, or another B2B technology environment.

  • Commercial performance: A history of building partnerships that generate measurable sales pipeline and revenue against targets.

  • Builder mentality: Comfortable developing new partner relationships and go-to-market motions from scratch rather than simply managing an established programme.

  • Executive presence: Strong communication and presentation skills, with the credibility to build relationships and negotiate with senior and C-level stakeholders.

  • Commercial judgment: Able to assess which opportunities are worth pursuing, structure mutually valuable partnerships, and focus time on the relationships most likely to produce meaningful results.

  • Cross-functional mindset: A low-ego, team-first approach and the ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, and other teams.

  • Based within commuting distance of our hub.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across Europe for partner meetings, conferences and events.
