About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is seeking a Senior Fullstack Engineer (BE-leaning) interested in working across the stack to join our fully distributed engineering team to help us continue our impressive growth from 2+ million daily active users to beyond! Our stack primarily includes Node.js, TypeScript, React.js and SQL.

As an engineering team, we design and build scalable systems using a service-oriented and event-driven architecture that serve millions of daily users and some of the largest youth and amateur sports organizations in the world. Our team values collaboration in a remote culture, so we regularly participate in pair sessions and virtual team swarms to stay connected and improve the team and company.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop engaging experiences for our millions of users across our mobile and web applications.

  • Design and implement scalable apps and services, integrating these into an evolving unified product and system architecture.

  • Brainstorm and evaluate new product features in collaboration with the product and UX team.

  • Collaborate and pair with other developers to develop solutions and teach technical skills.

  • Contribute to our development standards within the team and across engineering to ensure code quality, adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Champion and implement automated testing practices to uphold the dependability and stability of backend systems, while also taking ownership of the overall reliability of the team's services.

  • Actively engage in on-call responsibilities and contribute to incident management efforts.

  • Evaluate and test new technologies to help TeamSnap move faster or serve our users more effectively.

  • Help teammates overcome obstacles, resolve blockers, and complete work tasks.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience, leading large projects on high-scale, distributed software systems as a software engineer

  • Proficient in full stack development with Node, Python, Golang, Ruby, Javascript utilizing React or similar.

  • Experience with direct usage of SQL and relational databases such as MySQL / GCP Cloud SQL along with migrations, profiling, and optimization of such databases.

  • Hands-on experience developing APIs, services for mobile applications and web clients at scale.

  • Successfully delivered complex projects including debugging problems that may span a number of systems.

  • Experience working with and architecting APIs, event streams, webhooks, etc.

  • Experience working within and towards a distributed system.

  • Extra points if you’ve built services for livestreaming, advertising, or subscriptions.

Compensation

Additional Information

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $150,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

Total Rewards

• We're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

title: Principal Cloud Software Architect
description: Caylent is an AI-first cloud services company that helps organizations turn ambitious ideas into meaningful business impact. As an AWS Premier Tier Services Partner and a charter member of Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network, we combine deep expertise in AWS, artificial intelligence, and Anthropic’s Claude platform to help customers modernize their technology, build intelligent products, and move AI from experimentation into production. Our capabilities span generative and agentic AI, cloud migration and modernization, cloud-native application development, data and analytics, DevOps, managed services, security and compliance, and customer experience transformation. At Caylent, our people always come first. We are a fully remote global company with employees in Canada, the United States and Latin America. We celebrate the culture of each of our team members and foster a community of technological curiosity. Come talk to us to learn more about what it means to be a Caylien! The Mission We are seeking an exceptional Enterprise Architect to join our growing Cloud Native Applications team and lead delivery on Caylent's largest and most strategically important client engagements. The right candidate has deep expertise in designing and building applications, creating AI-first software solutions, and is energized by the scale, complexity, and stakes that come with our biggest accounts.. Your mission will be to work alongside and lead Caylent’s Software Engineers, Architects, Sales, and Project Managers to deliver for our largest and most complex customers. You’ll be hands-on with the latest technologies, operate confidently amid the ambiguity and competing priorities that large enterprise environments bring, and serve as a steady, senior presence — both for your team and in front of client leadership — when the stakes are highest. Your Assignment Lead software development project teams to deliver AI-first, production-ready solutions in environments with significant scale, technical complexity, and organizational complexity. Lead and own technical requirements gathering, technical decision making, backlog generation and refinement, and all architectural decisions - including where legacy systems, multiple integration points, or ambiguous requirements are in play. Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders, including senior technical and business leadership to gather customer requirements and formulate them into a workable backlog. Build architecture diagrams to document, communicate, and defend your solution design to both engineering teams and client leadership. Apply your expertise in AI-first software development as a hands-on, contributing member of the technical team. Create, automate, and refine multiple levels of AI-driven testing. Coach and mentor teammates, provide guidance and assistance to software engineers and share practices for leading high-stakes engagements with peer Enterprise Architects and Engineering Managers. Serve as the senior point of escalation on your engagement - identifying delivery risk, technical roadblocks, or relationship friction early, and stepping in to protect both the client relationship and the team. Own status reporting and communication with client leadership on your engagement, including presenting progress, risk, and roadmap in steering committees or business reviews. Collaborate with project managers, peers, and leaders to navigate client, technical, and team challenges with strong conflict resolution and leadership particularly across large, multi-stakeholder client organizations. Support pre-sales efforts through scope development discussions, contract document review, and client presentations when needed with particular focus on large or complex deals. Your Qualifications Core Consulting Qualifications Customer Experience Expertise in confidently addressing complex client questions, including from senior client stakeholders, and identifying gaps in requirements with proposed next steps. Focus on delivering clear, actionable solutions that meet client goals Collaboration Facilitate alignment across a wide range of stakeholders, technical priorities, and deliverables, including in organizationally complex client environments. Navigate differing, and sometimes competing, perspectives with professionalism to ensure shared understanding and progress. Communication Break down and communicate complex technical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences, including senior client stakeholders, in a clear, concise manner. Adapt communication style based on audience and context to improve clarity and decision-making. Technical Qualifications 8+ years of proven experience in software development and cloud-native systems. Experience managing professional services engagements and cross-functional projects, including engagements involving multiple stakeholders, legacy systems, or significant integration complexity. Strong background in established engineering practices and scalable architectures. Experience with more than one backend language such as Python, Node.js, C#, or TypeScript; and familiarity with frontend frameworks such as React, Vue, MVC, or .NET. Broad expertise is a plus, but proficiency across every technology listed is not required. Learning and building with AI both for productivity and for enhancing client solutions. Deep experience and expertise building with AWS. Knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL). Experience in API integrations across applications, vendors, and cloud environments. Understanding of modern application architectures including event-based systems, queues, microservices. Demonstrated ability to build credibility and trust with senior client stakeholders. Desire to integrate innovative technologies into development workflow. Proven ability to lead a workstream and support others while contributing individually, even under the added scale and visibility of large enterprise engagements.. Preferred Qualifications Degree in a computing-related field Experience with: UX/UI, LLMs, AgentCore, GenAI, automated testing, CI/CD, IaC Experience with large-scale system modernization or legacy migration Experience navigating enterprise IT governance processes (e.g., change advisory boards, security reviews, procurement cycles) Benefits Pay in USD 100% remote work Generous holidays and flexible PTO Competitive phantom equity Paid for exams and certifications Peer bonus awards State of the art laptop and tools Equipment & Office Stipend Individual professional development plan Annual stipend for Learning and Development Work with an amazing worldwide team and in an incredible corporate culture This role may require up to 25% travel, depending on business needs. NOTE: This position requires current legal authorization to work in the country where this position is located. Caylent is not able to sponsor visa or work permit applications at this time. At Caylent, we are committed to fair, transparent, and inclusive hiring practices. As part of our recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools or automated systems to assist with the screening and evaluation of applications to help match candidate qualifications with job requirements. These tools are designed to support — not replace — human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are always made by our trained recruitment professionals. If an AI or automated tool is used during your application process, it will only be in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, and your information will be handled in a secure and confidential manner. If you have any questions, please contact talent@caylent.com Caylent is a place where everyone belongs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Our approach helps us to build a winning team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and abilities. So, regardless of how your diversity expresses itself, you can find a home here at Caylent. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you would like to request an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at hr@caylent.com.

About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems.

You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework.

What you'll do

Build & Operate Production Systems

  • Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences

  • Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration

  • Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that deliver value to customers and enable other engineering teams to move faster

  • Own the production health of the systems you build, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance, reliability, and issue resolution

  • Build reusable infrastructure, frameworks, tooling, and developer experiences that enable teams across the organization

  • Improve engineering velocity and operational quality through automation, documentation, and continuous improvements

Drive Technical Excellence

  • Contribute to technical design for complex projects, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing pragmatic implementation plans

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions

  • Help identify and reduce technical debt, reliability risks, and friction in the software development lifecycle

  • Collaborate with Staff and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns and raise engineering standards

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and operational support

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development as a primary part of your workflow, deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, and regressions, shipping quality output regardless of how it was produced

  • Build or integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities in your domain where they add real value (e.g., evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries

  • Contribute to the team's evolving practices around AI-accelerated development, testing, and code review

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and cross-functional partners to meet timelines and align solutions to business goals

  • Provide clear, accessible technical context to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert with a deep understanding of the data, workflows, and customer needs specific to that space

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering

  • Strong backend engineering experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Pyramid, or Django

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, and operating services in production

  • Comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it (TypeScript/React experience a plus)

  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver pragmatic, maintainable solutions

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively across teams

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and cross-functional partners

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment), and demonstrated AI Fluency: a deliberate point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool, adapted code review practices for AI-generated code, and safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems in production (e.g., RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, evaluation workflows, guardrails, prompt/tool orchestration, or model observability)

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical territory where best practices and patterns are still being established

Nice to Have

  • Background in financial services or fintech

  • Experience with API gateway/infrastructure, security & governance tooling, retrieval and data-access systems, or agent frameworks at production scale

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $220,000 and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $210,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. Our commitment to creating a nurturing work environment is recognized by our certification as a Great Place to Work, where you will have opportunities for professional development, growth, and a chance to make a significant international impact.

We offer the convenience of remote work, allowing you to craft a work-life balance that suits your personal and professional needs. We're looking for candidates who are passionate about technology, proficient in English, and excited to engage in remote collaboration for a worldwide presence.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Kafka/AWS Integration Engineer to join a project focused on building and productionizing an event-driven middleware platform using Apache Kafka and AWS.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role where you will build the AWS side of the integration platform, with Salesforce serving as the initial event source. You will work alongside the Lead Integration Architect and within the Agile sprint process, implementing solutions based on an established architecture and prioritized backlog.

You will work across Apache Kafka, Amazon MSK, Java, Kafka Connect, Change Data Capture (CDC), AWS serverless technologies, and Infrastructure as Code, while helping establish reliable, testable, and maintainable event-driven integrations.

  • Provision and configure Amazon MSK clusters, Kafka topics, and schema registry.

  • Build Java-based integration pipelines to deliver events from outbound topics to downstream systems.
  • Implement dead letter queues and error-handling patterns for reliable event processing.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated tests, and code coverage.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure using AWS CloudFormation, enabling the client's operations team to redeploy and manage the environment.
  • Work within the client's Agile/sprint process and collaborate closely with the Lead Integration Architect.
  • Create clear technical documentation and provide ongoing knowledge transfer to the client's engineering and operations teams.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience developing backend and integration solutions with Java.
  • Professional experience building event-driven and Kafka-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience working with AWS services and cloud-based integrations.
  • Experience building and supporting production-grade integration pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, and production-quality software development practices.
  • Comfortable working within an Agile/sprint environment under the direction of a client architect.
  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to transfer technical knowledge effectively to client engineering and operations teams.
  • Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Must Have:

  • Strong Java development experience, including stream processing and API components.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and Amazon MSK, including:
  • Kafka clusters and topics
  • Kafka Connect
  • Change Data Capture (CDC)
  • Experience with Schema Registry, including schema versioning and evolution.
  • Strong experience with AWS serverless technologies, including:
  • API Gateway
  • AWS Lambda
  • Infrastructure-as-Code experience with AWS CloudFormation.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with automated testing and code coverage.
  • Experience building or supporting event-driven integration systems.
  • Comfortable working in an Agile/sprint environment under a client architect's direction.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills for technical knowledge transfer.
  • Advanced written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Salesforce CDC or Salesforce event integrations.
  • Experience implementing dead letter queues (DLQs) and error-handling patterns in event-driven systems. Kafka-AWS-Integration-Engineer.

GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role
We're looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Repository Services team in GitLab's Create stage. The team owns the repository side of Source Code: how code gets into a repository, who may change it, and how those changes are verified. We build this as an access layer on the primitives the Gitaly team provides, for GitLab's own features and for the artificial intelligence agents now writing and pushing code alongside people.
You'll work in one of GitLab's oldest and most complex product areas, using Ruby and GraphQL across GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Repository Services is a new team, and its first months are about reliability and support, so you'll spend real time on performance and structured query language tuning, caching, rate limiting, testing, observability, and resiliency, with experienced team members to lean on. You'll collaborate with product management, product design, testing, security, user experience research, technical writing, Gitaly, Code Review, and the other Source Code teams.

What you'll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
  • Design and maintain backend services, application programming interfaces, data models, and business logic that control how code reaches a repository, who may change it, and how it is verified.
  • Build on the primitives Gitaly provides and work closely with the Gitaly team.
  • Triage and fix bugs and support requests for the features the team owns.
  • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
  • Use artificial intelligence agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.
  • Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
  • Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you'll bring

  • Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.
  • Experience contributing to user-facing workflows and maintaining their underlying systems.
  • Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.
  • Experience using artificial intelligence coding agents and reviewing their output, or an interest in building these skills in a complex monorepo.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.

About the team
Repository Services is a small backend team in the Create stage, formed in September 2026 when Source Code split into focused teams. As the split is finalized we expect to own repository mirroring, Git Large File Storage (LFS), protected branches and Branch Rules, push rules, Code Owners (shared with Code Review), and commit and tag signing. We build on Gitaly's primitives and meet regularly with the Gitaly team, and our work serves GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated.

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

Key responsibilities

Certification strategy and project management

  • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

  • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

  • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

Safety engineering and risk analysis

  • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

  • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

  • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

  • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

Compliance and technical documentation

  • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

  • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

  • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

  • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

Collaboration and continuous improvement

  • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

  • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

Standards and regulatory scope

The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

  • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

Required qualifications

  • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

raw.jobDescription:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

As a Clinical Database Programmer (internally referred to as Database Programmer), you will support the development, testing and maintenance of Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems used in clinical trials.

Working within a collaborative and innovative technical team, you will be involved in building clinical studies, developing electronic Case Report Forms (eCRFs), configuring edit checks and supporting data integrations, primarily using Medidata Rave.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to new initiatives, explore AI-driven solutions and support continuous improvements in study development and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, test and maintain clinical study databases within EDC systems.

  • Develop and configure eCRFs, edit checks and study-specific database requirements.

  • Support clinical data transfers, integrations and database validation activities.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and provide ongoing EDC study support.

  • Collaborate with Data Management, project teams and sponsors to ensure successful study delivery.

  • Contribute to process improvements, automation and innovative solutions, including the use of AI.

  • Support multiple clinical studies and progressively take ownership of study builds.

  • Ensure database documentation, quality standards and study timelines are maintained.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • Previous experience in clinical database development, EDC programming or clinical study builds.

  • Previous experience within a CRO or pharmaceutical environment.

  • Knowledge of eCRFs, edit checks, database testing and clinical data management processes.

  • Understanding of programming principles, logic and database development.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.

  • Experience supporting EDC integrations, technical initiatives or bid defence activities.

  • Proactive team player with excellent communication skills and a continuous improvement mindset.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Medidata Rave, including study builds and configuration.

  • Knowledge of C# programming and development of custom functions within Medidata Rave.

  • Experience with AI tools, automation or AI-assisted programming to improve study development and efficiency.

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

title: Senior Product Designer
description: Do you think in journeys, not just screens? Can you see where a learner gets stuck, where a buyer needs proof of value, and where an upgrade feels like a natural next step rather than a sales pitch? And do you want to be the person who sets the design direction for a whole product, not one corner of it? AIHR is looking for a Senior Product Designer to be the sole designer on our product team. You'll shape our learning platform end to end: how HR professionals discover content and keep learning, how teams see the value of learning, and how our design system helps everyone build consistently and fast. You'll work across both product squads as a hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. About AIHR Founded in 2016 with the mission to future-proof HR, the Academy to Innovate HR (AIHR) has become the world’s market leader in online training for human resources (HR) professionals. We have a global customer base spread across 140+ countries, amongst which companies like Unilever, Reckitt, Goldman Sachs, Philips, Deloitte, Nike, Heineken, and UBS. It is our goal to continuously upskill and empower 1,000,000 HR Professionals. We are an international team of 100+ people, driven by excellence, innovation, and a hunger to grow in everything we do. As such, we strive to provide the world’s best courses and excellent support to our customers while continuously optimizing every aspect of our work. With over 30 nationalities, our team is diverse, yet we all share a few traits: we're friendly, enthusiastic, and great team players. Being a fast-growing company, working at AIHR means taking on a lot of responsibility and getting countless opportunities to develop yourself in new areas and potential to craft your own role. Why a designer now We built the AIHR Academy for individual HR professionals who choose to learn on their own. That focus got us here. Now we're at a pivotal point: we're taking the full learning experience, our internal expertise and our content into the B2B market. That shift opens the platform to new personas with different needs. A learner whose employer provides their license comes in with different motivations than someone who paid for themselves. And a manager or buyer needs to see team progress, skill gaps and return on investment before they renew. Much of today's experience wasn't designed with them in mind. Role and Responsibilities As our Senior Product Designer , you own the user experience across the AIHR Academy, from how learners discover content to how buyers decide whether to renew. You represent the user in every product conversation and help the team make better decisions, faster. You report to the Head of Product and work daily with our Learner Experience and Manager Experience Squads, their Product Managers, front-end engineers and our Learning Consultants. PMs already prototype with AI tools, and you’ll help them do that well within the guardrails you set. Journeys and engagement Map and design end-to-end journeys for each persona, from first visit to long-term learning habit. Shape how learners discover content and keep coming back. You know which engagement mechanics, like progress, milestones and social learning, suit busy professionals and which feel gimmicky. Propose ideas quickly, test them pragmatically and learn from the data. Growth surfaces Design the moments where members and B2B customers upgrade and renew, as part of the wider journey rather than as standalone funnels. Tread the line between commercial goals and product quality. You know when an upgrade moment helps someone see more value and when it costs trust, and you bring a clear way of making that call that the team can learn from. Craft and UI ownership You don't stop at concepts. You turn decisions into clear, high-fidelity work in Figma, so engineers can build with confidence. During implementation, you're the go-to partner for front-end engineers and co-own the UI with them. You bring the cases and the fidelity, they bring the constraints and the shipping, and you resolve gaps together until what's live matches the intent. Design system and enablement Own our design system. You keep it up to date, audit it regularly across the product and turn what you find into your own improvement ideas and a prioritized plan. Set the bar and the guardrails that others build within. You raise the standard of the whole system, not just individual screens, and make it easy for others to prototype with. How you work You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision. You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision. You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign. On a typical week On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You check whether the upgrade prompt comes after users have seen enough value, and you propose a few changes to the PRD to ensure the proper UX guardrails are applied throughout the experience. On Wednesday morning, you lead a cross-functional brainstorm with Marion, PM of the Manager Experience Squad, and our Learning Consultants. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves. In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details. On Friday, you review the pages the team shipped over the past month. You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. Then you join the monthly business update, where the founders share the previous month's results with everyone, and end the week with drinks at our weekly team activity, a chance to unwind and get to know colleagues who recently joined. We offer A key role in shaping the learning experience for tens of thousands of HR professionals worldwide, bridging the gap between user experience and world-class visual execution; Competitive, benchmarked compensation; The opportunity to shape your own day-to-day work; Regular growth talks and support to reach your career goals; Flexible working hours & working from home arrangements A high degree of autonomy in a vibrant, result-driven, inclusive, and international team; A key role in a fast-growing scale-up company; A beautiful office right across Rotterdam Central Station (Milleniumtower) and a brand new office in Amsterdam; 26 paid holidays per year + 1 extra day for the first 5 years you work here Exchange any 2 public holiday days for 2 other days of your choice; Work from anywhere policy, where you can work abroad for 20 days in a calendar year; Pension plan; 5 Mental health days per year; Access to OpenUp mental health platform; Personal development budget, training, and we pay for the books you read; All public transport expenses covered (NS Business Card); MacBook + all other equipment you need to do your work; Daily lunch prepared by a chef, weekly drinks, and fun team activities; Free access to the office gym. Apply for the job Are you excited to become our Senior Product Designer ? Then we'd love to hear from you! We are looking to hire for this role as soon as we find an eligible candidate. P.S. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women tend to apply only when they meet 100% of them. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point above, please still apply. We'd love to consider you and see if you could be a great fit. Who you are You're a senior product designer who thinks in journeys, enjoys wearing multiple hats and gets energy from being the team's go-to, hands-on designer and the team’s go-to for design advice. You could be our ideal candidate if: You have at least 5 years of experience as a product designer in B2B SaaS, preferably in elearning, content platforms, or HR tech. You’ve been the sole or lead designer before, so you know how to hold a high quality bar without a design team around you. You've designed products that work seamlessly for several different personas . You've designed engagement and growth moments that work for users and the business, and you can explain how you decided where to draw the line. You think about the whole journey, not just conversion. You take a pragmatic approach to research and behavioral design. You know when a quick test is enough and when a decision needs deeper evidence. You've owned a design system and have the taste to keep raising its standard. You use Figma as your primary craft tool and AI daily to shape your and the team’s workflow. You enjoy turning ideas into build-ready mockups and helping others do the same. You see feedback as a way to improve the work , hold your ground with data and principles, and change course when the evidence says so. You're fluent in English and able to work from our Rotterdam office at least 2 days a week. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

How you work

  • You're a partner to Product Managers. You help define problems, challenge assumptions and bring the user's perspective into every decision.

  • You stay with the work after a design is approved. You assess feasibility with engineers early, adapt designs when constraints appear and bring the trade-offs back to Product for a decision.

  • You know where your time matters most. You can easily see when a journey needs a deep dive, when a quick sketch will do and when the right move is feedback on someone else's prototype rather than a redesign.

On Monday morning, you join the Product Weekly for a rundown of the week's priorities. Silvia shares the outcomes of the latest leadership quarterly meeting, and how this impacts product priorities. 

In the afternoon, you review a prototype from Alice, PM of the Learner Experience Squad, for a new upgrade flow that moves AI for HR Academy users to a Team Access license. You first share your prototype for feedback, and together you work out how to help buyers identify their team's skill gaps and build tailored learning journeys themselves.

In the afternoon, you join the Learner Experience Squad's refinement to get feedback on the technical feasibility of a new bootcamp design. Based on what you hear, you set up a follow-up with the engineers, including Aliia, Front-End Engineer, to dig into the details.

You find inconsistencies in some components across pages, create a ticket to fix them in the design system and update the prototyping skill so PMs build with the latest version. title: Medior / Senior Data Analyst
description: SQL in BigQuery? Gesneden koek. Een dashboard in Looker Studio? Staat er zo. Maar jij wil meer. Je wil weten welk verhaal er achter de cijfers zit, en je vertelt dat verhaal net zo graag. Met een advies waar klanten en collega’s echt iets mee kunnen. AI zet je daarbij vanzelfsprekend in, om sneller en slimmer tot de kern te komen. Wij zijn Follo: een snelgroeiend, award-winning digital agency (ontstaan uit de fusie van vier topbureaus) waar data de basis is onder alles wat we doen. Als Medior Data Analist werk je zelfstandig voor een eigen set klanten en projecten, samen met onze Data & Analytics Consultants en de specialisten in Search en Social. Je levert niet alleen de cijfers, je vertelt ook wat ze betekenen en wat er moet gebeuren. Wat je gaat doen Je analyseert data uit onder andere GA4, advertentieplatformen en CRM- en e-commercesystemen en ontdekt zo trends, kansen en knelpunten. Je zet AI actief in om sneller patronen te herkennen, hypotheses te toetsen, SQL te schrijven en grote datasets te doorgronden, zonder je kritische blik op de uitkomsten te verliezen. Je presenteert je bevindingen aan klanten en collega’s en vertaalt ze naar heldere, commerciële aanbevelingen. Je komt zelf met verbetervoorstellen voor marketing, meetopzet en businessprocessen, en kijkt verder dan de vraag. Je schrijft SQL in BigQuery en bouwt aan schone, herbruikbare datamodellen (bijvoorbeeld in Dataform), zodat databronnen goed gekoppeld zijn en iedereen met dezelfde definities werkt. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt overzichtelijke dashboards en rapportages in onder andere Looker Studio, en bepaalt mee welke KPI’s er echt toe doen en hoe je die het best visualiseert. Je bewaakt de betrouwbaarheid van data, signaleert afwijkingen en spoort de oorzaak op, of die nu in de tracking, de koppeling of het model zit. Je maakt terugkerend werk slimmer met automatisering en AI, en deelt je kennis met het team. Wat je van ons mag verwachten Een salaris tussen de €3.250 en €5.000, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Een ambitieus team waarin verantwoordelijkheid en samenwerken voorop staan. 26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen. Een eenmalig thuiswerkbudget tot €1.000 om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. Een goed geregeld pensioen, zonder eigen bijdrage. De vrijheid om hybride te werken, zodat jij het best tot je recht komt. Interne kennissessies, events en brainstorms, van AI en automatisering tot data deep-dives. Dit ben jij Je bent een analist met oog voor detail die het grotere plaatje blijft zien. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe data begrijpelijk te maken voor anderen. Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende: Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring als data analist of in een vergelijkbare rol. Je bent communicatief sterk: je legt een analyse net zo makkelijk uit aan een marketing manager als aan een developer, en je durft met een onderbouwd advies te komen. Je beheerst SQL goed; ervaring met BigQuery is een grote pré. Je hebt ruime ervaring met dashboarding in Looker Studio, Power BI of een vergelijkbare tool. Je kent GA4 en begrijpt hoe online marketingdata tot stand komt. Ervaring met Google Tag Manager is een pré. Je gebruikt AI al in je dagelijkse analysewerk, of hebt de sterke ambitie om dat te doen. Kennis van Python of ervaring met Dataform of dbt is mooi meegenomen. Waarom Follo? Bij Follo is data geen bijproduct van marketing, maar het fundament eronder. Van Search en Social tot Marketplaces en CRO: elke strategie begint bij betrouwbare data en scherpe inzichten. AI is bij ons geen buzzword, maar onderdeel van hoe we dagelijks werken. Minder handwerk, meer tijd voor analyse, advies en impact. Data als fundament: met de FolloEngine, ons eigen platform voor data intelligence, datakwaliteit en automatisering, start je met een voorsprong. AI in je dagelijkse werk: je werkt met de nieuwste tools en technieken, van AI-gedreven analyse tot geautomatiseerde workflows. Sterke merken, echte vraagstukken: jouw analyses sturen de beslissingen van ambitieuze adverteerders. Werken aan internationale, award-waardige cases in een bureau met Europese ambities. title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie of Accountancy. Je bent nauwkeurig en analytisch ingesteld en werkt makkelijk met Excel en grotere datasets. Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels goed, in woord en geschrift. Wat kun je van ons verwachten? Een stagevergoeding van € 650 per maand (bij fulltime). Een leerzame stage met veel ruimte voor zelfstandigheid, verantwoordelijkheid en eigen initiatief. Werken vanuit ons Basecamp: een moderne werkomgeving met uitzicht over de Waterweg, een gym, restaurant en de DH Academy. Professionele begeleiding en de kans om echt iets bij te dragen. Een fijne werksfeer met de Rotterdamse mentaliteit. Enthousiast? Klinkt dit als jouw stage? Solliciteer dan direct via de knop op deze pagina. Wil je eerst meer weten? title: Business Development Manager
description: Grosse Veränderungen beginnen mit Menschen, die mehr erreichen wollen. Wie kommen Mitarbeitende zur Arbeit? Warum stehen Firmenautos ungenutzt herum, während Parkplätze knapp sind? Und wie wird nachhaltige Mobilität zur attraktivsten Wahl? Bei Urban Connect machen wir aus diesen Herausforderungen konkrete Lösungen. Wir verbinden geteilte E-Bikes und Firmenautos, öffentliche Verkehrsmittel, Mobilitätsbudgets und digitales Parkplatzmanagement auf einer Plattform. Damit helfen wir Unternehmen, Kosten zu senken, Ressourcen besser zu nutzen und ihren Mitarbeitenden mehr Freiheit zu geben. Unternehmen wie Roche, Google, SWISS und Lonza setzen bereits auf uns. Unser Anspruch geht weiter: Wir wollen die Art verändern, wie Unternehmen Mobilität organisieren. Und wir bieten das Betriebssystem, das dies möglich macht. Um diese Vision zu verwirklichen, suchen wir eine neugierige, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, Energie und gutes Urteilsvermögen mitbringt und mit uns das Unternehmen und die Mobilitätsbranche voranbringen möchte. Deine Rolle: echte Verantwortung, spürbare Wirkung Du möchtest ein Unternehmen mitgestalten, anspruchsvolle Probleme lösen und sehen, was deine Arbeit bewirkt. Als Business Development Manager arbeitest du eng mit unserem Sales- und Account-Management-Team sowie mit Product, Technology und Operations zusammen. Du entwickelst aus Kundenbedürfnissen, Daten und Marktkenntnissen überzeugende Mobilitätslösungen und konkrete Wachstumschancen. Du verantwortest Projekte, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst ihre Umsetzung voran. Wir erwarten, dass du von Anfang an durchdachte Fragen stellst, erkennst, wo du einen Beitrag leisten kannst, und ins Handeln kommst. Dabei unterstützen dich Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die wollen, dass du erfolgreich bist. Was du bei uns bewegst Aus Daten Chancen machen: Du analysierst Nutzungs- und Marktdaten, etwa zur Auslastung von Fahrzeugen und Parkplätzen, und entwickelst daraus umsetzbare Empfehlungen für bessere betriebliche Mobilitätslösungen. raw.title: Erfahrener SAP Personalberater / Headhunter - Schwerpunkt Kandidatengewinnung
raw.description:
Die besten SAP-Spezialisten der Schweiz suchen keinen Job, sie wollen angesprochen werden. Für das «Who is Who» der Schweizer Wirtschaft finden, überzeugen und begleiten wir genau diese Menschen. VANGARD ist eine auf SAP spezialisierte Headhunting-Boutique mit dem Anspruch: Headhunting. Nicht Recruiting.

Warum VANGARD, gerade jetzt

Der Markt für Personaldienstleister ist unter Druck, viele Agenturen kämpfen. Wir stehen auf einem soliden Fundament: Seit 2012 sind wir im Schweizer SAP-Markt aktiv, haben bei über 400 SAP-Arbeitgebern platziert und sind in der SAP-Community bestens etabliert. Jährlich veröffentlichen wir das White Paper «SAP-Arbeitsmarkt Schweiz», mit Interviews von Branchenführern aus SAP-Beratung und Inhouse-Organisationen. Und dank unseres eigenen CRM-Systems vermessen und mappen wir den Schweizer SAP-Markt systematisch, wie kaum jemand sonst.

Für dich heisst das: Du musst nicht jeden Monat bei null anfangen.

Deine Rolle

Du spürst Top-SAP-Spezialisten auf, für die sonst niemand einen Zugang findet. Du gewinnst ihr Vertrauen, verstehst ihre Ziele und begleitest sie bis zur Vertragsunterschrift und darüber hinaus. Unser Kandidatenpool mit tausenden Profilen, unsere gewachsenen Beziehungen und unser erprobtes Headhunting-Konzept geben dir vom ersten Tag an Rückenwind.

Deine Aufgaben

Kandidatengewinnung

  • Systematisches Mapping des SAP-Markts: Wer arbeitet wo, in welchem Modul, mit welchem Erfahrungsprofil?

  • Gezielte Direktansprache passiver SAP-Spezialisten über Telefon, Netzwerk, Empfehlungen und LinkedIn

  • Aufspüren von Talenten, die auf keiner Jobbörse und oft nicht einmal auf LinkedIn sichtbar sind

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Reaktivierung unseres Kandidatenpools

  • Aufbau eines eigenen Netzwerks in der Schweizer SAP-Community, mit Empfehlungen als festem Bestandteil deiner Arbeit

Qualifizierung und Präsentation

  • Fundierte Interviews zur fachlichen und persönlichen Qualifizierung, von Modulwissen und Projekterfahrung bis zu Karrieremotivation und Wechselbereitschaft

  • Ehrliche Einschätzung, welche Position wirklich passt, statt Kandidaten in die erstbeste Stelle zu schieben

Betreuung durch den gesamten Prozess

  • Persönliche Begleitung jedes Kandidaten als feste Ansprechperson, vom ersten Gespräch bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

  • Individuelle Interviewvorbereitung, Gehaltsbenchmarks und ehrliches Feedback nach jedem Gespräch

  • Begleitung durch Debriefings, Gehalts- und Vertragsverhandlungen

  • Souveräner Umgang mit Gegenangeboten, Zweifeln und kritischen Momenten im Entscheidungsprozess

  • Nachbetreuung nach dem Start, damit Platzierungen langfristig tragen und aus Kandidaten Botschafter werden

Zusammenarbeit mit den Key Account Managern

  • Projektarbeit in enger Abstimmung mit unseren Key Account Managern

  • Bei Eignung Einbindung in die Kundengewinnung und -betreuung, etwa durch Teilnahme an Briefings und Kundenterminen

Was du mitbringst

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der SAP- oder IT-Personalberatung, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt Direktansprache

  • Einen nachweisbaren Track-Record im Gewinnen und Platzieren von Spezialisten, die nicht aktiv suchen

  • Gutes Verständnis der SAP-Welt: Du weisst, was einen FI/CO-Berater von einem EWM-Spezialisten unterscheidet

  • Die richtige Mischung aus Ausstrahlung und Hartnäckigkeit, am Telefon wie im persönlichen Gespräch

  • Eine Art, die Menschen öffnet: Kandidaten rufen dich zurück, weil sie gerne mit dir sprechen, und hören dir auch nach dem dritten Nein noch zu

  • Humor, Drive und die Gelassenheit, auch in hektischen Phasen den richtigen Ton zu treffen

  • Stilsicheres Deutsch und gutes Englisch

Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein stabiles Umfeld in einer gefragten Nische, mit gefülltem Pool und etablierten Beziehungen statt Kaltstart

  • Erfahrene Mentoren mit über 10 Jahren SAP-Headhunting-Erfahrung, die dich mit viel Engagement, Know-how und Freude an deinem Erfolg unterstützen

  • Ein solides Fixum und ein variabler Anteil, der deutlich über dem der grossen Personaldienstleister liegt: Bei gleichem Erfolg verdienst du bei uns unter dem Strich mehr

  • Ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echtem Teamspirit

  • Ein super modernes Office in Zürich-Greencity mit neuester IT

Was du sonst noch wissen solltest

Bei uns ist jeder Tag anders, die Pace ist hoch, und Kandidaten wie Unternehmen erwarten eine Beratung auf höchstem Niveau. Dafür brauchst du Fokus, Engagement und Freude an Menschen. raw.jobDescription:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// At Masabi, we're powering the journeys of millions by making public transport payments simple, accessible, and seamless.

We're looking for Backend Developers to help build and evolve the services at the heart of our Justride platform. You'll work on cloud-native, event-driven systems that run at scale for transit agencies around the world, from fare and ticketing logic to the APIs and integrations that connect riders, operators and partners.

As part of a cross-functional team, you'll work closely with engineers, testers and product partners to take features from idea to production. What you build will shape the experience of riders every day.

Location_

// This is a fully remote contract role for people based in Romania

Responsibilities_

  • Build and maintain backend services and APIs that power core parts of the Justride platform

  • Contribute to the design of scalable, secure and resilient distributed systems

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features from concept through to production

  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable code and contribute to code reviews and shared engineering standards

  • Build and support integrations with internal services and third-party systems

  • Monitor and improve the performance, reliability and observability of the services you own

  • Contribute to technical discussions and help shape solutions and best practices

  • Take ownership of your work and support team outcomes

About You_

  • Clear, confident communication in written and spoken English

  • Solid commercial experience building backend systems in Java or Kotlin

  • Understanding of distributed systems and how to build for scale and reliability

  • Comfortable designing and working with REST APIs and service-based or event-driven architectures

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, ideally AWS

  • A thoughtful approach to code quality, testing and maintainability

  • Collaborative and team-oriented, happy to share knowledge and learn from others

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset

  • Able to explain technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical colleagues

We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

What You'll Learn_

  • How a global fare payment platform works at scale, used by transit agencies and millions of riders

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture, Kafka, AWS and infrastructure as code

  • How to deliver in a cross-functional, international team where developers help shape the technical direction

Our Stack_

  • Java/Kotlin (nice to have)

  • Event-driven architecture, RESTful APIs

  • AWS (DynamoDB, S3, SQS, EC2, ECS etc.)

  • Kafka

  • Terraform

  • Grafana

  • Gradle, Maven, Git

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: Engineering Manager
description: Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more. We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA. Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era. About the role We're looking for an exceptional Senior Engineering Manager to lead 10–12 engineers across our Secrets Management and Certificate Management teams. Secrets Management delivers over 10 billion secrets monthly, while Certificate Management supports PKI, certificate lifecycle automation, and signing release artifacts and binaries. Both products support cloud and self-hosted deployments, including on-premises and air-gapped environments. You'll be responsible for developing a high-performing engineering team, driving execution across both products, and ensuring our infrastructure remains secure and reliable. You'll work closely with our CTO and Tech Leads, staying deeply technical while empowering engineers to own their work. You'll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to: Own engineering delivery: Drive execution across both teams, establish clear commitments, manage competing priorities, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality work. Hire and develop engineers: Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development. Build a high-performing team and develop strong Tech Leads. Shape engineering priorities: Balance customer needs and product development with investments in security, reliability, and developer velocity. Own reliability and engineering quality: Establish reliability targets and drive improvements in observability, incident response, and operational quality. Stay technically involved: Know when to zoom out and when to dive deep. Review code and technical designs, and work with Tech Leads to guide important architectural decisions and resolve difficult engineering challenges. Work directly with customers: Understand their workflows and technical requirements, and translate those insights into engineering priorities. Improve how the team operates: Establish lightweight processes that keep execution fast, predictable, and accountable. Requirements 6+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years managing engineers, ideally in developer tooling, infrastructure security, or other high-stakes developer software. A strong track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and developing technical leaders. Experience leading multiple engineering workstreams and driving execution through others. Strong hands-on engineering background. You're comfortable reviewing production code and technical designs. Strong engineering fundamentals and sound judgment around system architecture, reliability, and technical tradeoffs. Excellent communication skills, including the ability to work directly with customers. A bias toward action, with the ability to make decisions with incomplete information and maintain high standards while moving quickly. Based in the US or Canada (NYC preferred). Nice to have Experience working in security infrastructure or developer tools. Experience leading teams developing distributed systems. A track record of using AI tools to increase engineering output while maintaining production security, availability and reliability commitments. Team, values & benefits Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings. At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available, with more details on our careers page .
