title: Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager
description:
About Lucid

At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 

We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.

The Senior Key Corporate Sales Manager is responsible for developing and executing Lucid Motors’ European B2B sales strategy, driving sustainable growth across key accounts, enterprise customers, leasing companies, rental operators, and fleet and mobility partners.

This role identifies new business opportunities, develops strategic partnerships, negotiates commercial agreements, and delivers sales, revenue, and profitability targets. The role also leads and develops a team of Corporate Sales Managers and supports Lucid’s importer markets to ensure consistent execution across Europe.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Business Development

  • Identify, develop, and secure new business opportunities with enterprise customers, corporate fleets, leasing companies, rental operators, and mobility providers.
  • Position Lucid as a preferred premium electric vehicle partner and develop strategic account plans that support sustainable growth.

Sales Strategy & Commercial Performance

  • Develop and execute the European corporate sales strategy in line with Lucid’s growth objectives.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop competitive vehicle, financing, and service propositions.
  • Deliver sales, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.

Strategic Account & Partnership Management

  • Build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers at major corporate accounts and strategic partners.
  • Understand customer fleet and mobility requirements and provide tailored commercial solutions.
  • Manage relationships with leasing, rental, fleet, mobility, and importer partners across Europe.

Commercial Negotiations

  • Lead complex negotiations and contract discussions with strategic customers and partners.
  • Structure commercial agreements that create long-term value for Lucid and its customers.

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, fleet market developments, and emerging mobility solutions.
  • Provide regular performance reporting, customer insights, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.

Leadership & Customer Experience

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Corporate Sales Managers.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and commercial excellence.
  • Ensure a consistent premium customer and partner experience throughout the sales lifecycle.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in automotive B2B sales, fleet sales, corporate sales, key account management, or mobility solutions.
  • Proven experience developing business and managing strategic accounts across multiple European markets.
  • Strong knowledge of fleet sales, leasing, financing, electric vehicles, total cost of ownership, and mobility trends.
  • Demonstrated success in delivering revenue growth, profitability, market share, and customer retention.
  • Proven experience leading and developing high-performing sales teams.
  • Experience negotiating complex commercial agreements and strategic partnerships.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, supported by a data-driven approach.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance systems; Salesforce experience is preferred.
  • Results-oriented and entrepreneurial, with a strong interest in innovation and electric mobility.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are advantageous.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 

Lucid Motors is committed to maintaining a safe and trustworthy environment. As such, a background check may be required during the hiring process. This will be performed in line with European data protection laws, and candidates will be informed and asked to provide consent before the check is conducted.

Compensation & Benefits: Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off.  Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid’s equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

Zo combineren we de voordelen van een groot bedrijf met de warme, persoonlijke sfeer van kleinschaliger teams: de waardestromen. Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra). Met oog op een langdurige relatie bieden we je na 2 maanden proeftijd een onbepaalde tijd contract. 43 verlofdagen volgens de cao Bouw & Infra. Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico's, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap. Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500 sportlocaties door heel Nederland. title: Afstudeerstage Werktuigbouwkunde - Constructieve perrons
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Help mee om perrons slimmer, duurzamer en toekomstbestendig te maken voor reizend Nederland. Dit ga je doen bij Movares onderzoek hoe constructieve perrons slimmer, duurzamer en circulair ontworpen kunnen worden; analyseer bestaande perrons en innovatieve oplossingen met nieuwe materialen; breng kansen voor kostenbesparing, minder materiaalgebruik en snellere bouw in kaart; werk optimalisaties uit en toets de technische haalbaarheid; adviseer over vervolgstappen en presenteer jouw onderzoeksresultaten aan experts. Constructieve perrons spelen een belangrijke rol in een betrouwbaar spoor. Samen met specialisten van Movares en ProRail onderzoek je hoe deze perrons slimmer en duurzamer kunnen worden ontworpen. Je vergelijkt bestaande oplossingen met innovatieve alternatieven, zoals composietconstructies, en vertaalt jouw bevindingen naar concrete verbeteringen voor de praktijk. Dit ben jij bij Movares Voor deze vacature breng jij mee: je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde of Civiele Techniek; je hebt kennis van constructies, materiaaleigenschappen, statica of dynamica; je bent nieuwsgierig en onderzoekend, stelt scherpe vragen en onderbouwt keuzes; je bent initiatiefrijk, verkent actief nieuwe ideeën en denkt in oplossingen; je werkt verbindend, zoekt gemakkelijk samenwerking op en deelt inzichten helder. Een stage bij Movares is een kickstart van je carrière, en dat heeft verschillende redenen. Zo kun je erop rekenen dat de begeleiding door jouw stagebegeleider, je team én campus recruiter Noortje op-en-top voor elkaar is. Daarnaast kom je terecht in een groep vol gelijkgestemden. Elk jaar verwelkomen we namelijk tussen de 30 en 40 stagiaires. Hen ontmoet je tijdens de maandelijkse bijeenkomsten van Movares Backstage, waar verbinden met anderen voorop staat. Soms gaan jullie samen lunchen of bezoeken jullie een project. Andere maanden staat er een inhoudelijke sessie op de planning en leer je bijvoorbeeld beter presenteren of adviseren. En ook als lid van Young Movares , onze jongerenvereniging, staan er regelmatig leuke activiteiten in je agenda. Daarnaast kun je elke tweede dinsdag van de maand aanschuiven bij het Café van de Toekomst: een inspiratiesessie waarbij je samen met je collega’s wordt bijgepraat over onderwerpen en projecten die in onze organisatie spelen. En dat is nog niet alles: je kunt gebruikmaken van onze eigen Academy met ruim 3.000 verschillende leerlijnen, trainingen en e-learningmodules. Dit krijg je bij Movares Bij Movares werk je mee aan een uitdagende opdracht met volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Er hangt een leuke en gezellige sfeer. Je krijgt een kijkje in de keuken van een toonaangevend advies- en ingenieursbureau, volop ruimte voor eigen initiatief en goede begeleiding. De duur en startdatum zijn in overleg nader te bepalen. Verder krijg je: een aantrekkelijke vergoeding van €550 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband; ruimte voor het vinden van jouw ideale werk-privé-balans; leuke collega’s en een afstudeerplek in hartje Utrecht. En er is méér. Want afstuderen bij Movares betekent ook: bijdragen aan een schone wereld, omdat je stageloopt bij het eerste bedrijf in Nederland met een Zero Waste-certificaat; lid worden van Young Movares, de jongerenvereniging waar je leert van én met andere jonge collega’s. Jouw team bij Movares Voor jou als afstudeerstagiair(e) Constructieve Perrons is er plek op onze afdeling Integraal Ontwerpen in team W-installaties. Binnen dit team werken collega's met verschillende technische achtergronden samen aan duurzame en toekomstbestendige oplossingen voor het spoor. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken werkomgeving waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Tijdens jouw afstudeerstage werk je nauw samen met specialisten op het gebied van constructies, geotechniek en dynamica. Ook heb je contact met ProRail en leveranciers. De sfeer is inhoudelijk sterk, maar tegelijkertijd laagdrempelig. Je krijgt veel ruimte om zelfstandig onderzoek uit te voeren, ideeën te toetsen en jouw resultaten te bespreken met ervaren collega's. title: Afstudeerstage Systems & Control - Slimme wisselverwarming
description: Jouw impact bij Movares Maak wisselverwarming slimmer en bespaar energie op het spoor. Dit ga je doen bij Movares je analyseert weerdata en gegevens van wisselverwarming en onderzoekt verbanden; je onderzoekt hoe een vooruitkijkende regeling het energieverbruik kan verlagen; je ontwikkelt en test een regeling voor het slimmer aansturen van wisselverwarming; je onderzoekt of de regeling technisch toepasbaar is binnen een programmeerbare besturing; je brengt de mogelijke energiebesparing en haalbaarheid van jouw oplossing in beeld. Wisselverwarming houdt spoorwissels vrij van sneeuw en ijs, maar verbruikt daarbij veel energie. Headquarters: Cyprus - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

As a CloudOps Engineer at Wrike, you have advanced skills in supporting cloud and on-prem data center infrastructure with security in mind. You know how to work with containers, networking, monitoring, automation, and debugging a reasonably complex infrastructure. You feel comfortable defining your own work based on the team OKRs. You can also help others do so when necessary. You are used to proposing meaningful improvements to the existing infrastructure in alignment with architects and tech leads, and you can drive the execution

In this specific role, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Network Infrastructure across hybrid environments. You bring deep, hands-on expertise in architecting resilient network topologies, configuring core routing and switching, managing firewalls, and securing connectivity between cloud providers and on-premise data centers.

Your Impact: 

  • Keep our infrastructure and company information safe with reliable network security
  • Keep our services running smoothly and fast for users around the clock
  • Managing the Wrike product infrastructure
  • Implementing reliable solutions to ensure a product uptime SLA of 99.9%
  • Working with GCP, AWS and other cloud providers in the IaC paradigm
  • Introducing and supporting new infrastructure services
  • Actively participating in incident response and management, including on-call duties
  • Developing and maintaining professional connections within and outside of the team

Your Qualifications: 

  • Juniper/Cisco devices underlying network infra
  • Kubernetes and ArgoCD
  • Nginx, HAproxy and Istio for load balancing
  • GCP, AWS and Cloudflare are our main cloud providers
  • Puppet, Ansible and Terraform for defining everything as a code
  • Python to automate everything
  • Prometheus (VictoriaMetrics) and Zabbix for monitoring
  • Graylog, Logstash, Fluentd for logging
  • Jenkins and Gitlab-CI for building pipelines
  • Upper Intermediate English skills

Standout Qualities: 

  • Experience with working with enterprise-grade infrastructure and SaaS solutions
  • Profound knowledge of network technologies, data transmission protocols, network architecture, and equipment
  • Experience working with BGP, OSPF, EVPN, STP, IPsec protocols
  • Familiarity with Linux, iptables, Nginx, HAproxy, and keepalive
  • Understanding of information security principles and the ability to apply them to network architecture
  • Sufficient scripting skills in Python/Bash or other scripting languages
  • Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills

Team Dynamics: 

  • Your manager will be Dmitrii Vlasov, SysOps Team Lead 
  • We have two dozen folks in the SysOps Department, consisting of four teams distributed in Prague, Nicosia, Rennes and Tallinn

Our Work Style:

  • Scrum based processes (daily standups, biweekly plannings, quarterly plannings)
  • Hybrid mode (1-2 days per week)
  • On-call shifts in production and development environments

What’s Next?

  • Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  • Technical interview
  • Cultural interview

Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)
  • Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees
  • Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.


#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona 

  Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. You'll be the engineer who owns autonomous systems across that footprint as one security domain, from both sides: drones, ground robots and automated vehicles for patrol, inspection and moving hardware, including the security of that automation inside secure areas, and the detection systems that tell us what is flying over or operating near a site uninvited. You set the approach, select and integrate the platforms and sensors, write the requirements vendors build to, and run what you ship, from the operating model where operators assign missions and machines carry them out to the playbook that turns a detection into an identified track and a well-evidenced handoff to whoever holds authority over the airspace. Interdiction is not part of this role. The goal is security that runs itself: coverage, fleet health and evidence verified continuously, with tools and AI agents doing the routine triage. We favor simple, standard controls and tools that can be verified over elaborate ones. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, including its physical security systems engineers and the engineers on its security monitoring platform, with Anthropic's data center operations and legal teams, and directly with site operators, equipment vendors and aviation and public safety authorities. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. Carrot is looking for a Sr. IT Systems Engineer to design, scale, and secure the identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms that power our global, remote-first workforce. This role sits at the center of IT engineering. If you want broad technical ownership, influence over the IT roadmap, and the chance to build systems that grow with a high-growth healthcare company, this role was built for that.

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Architect and own Carrot's identity, endpoint, and SaaS platforms, including Okta, JAMF, Intune, and Google Workspace, with a focus on security, reliability, and user experience
  • Lead design and rollout of larger IT initiatives, such as zero-trust access models, device compliance frameworks, and global endpoint standards
  • Build and maintain automation and infrastructure as code that manage configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows at scale
  • Partner with Information Security to design controls, drive vulnerability management, and keep Carrot audit-ready for SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security reviews
  • Serve as the senior technical escalation point, leading incident response and root cause analysis for complex or high-impact issues
  • Define engineering standards, runbooks, and documentation, and mentor IT teammates to grow their technical depth
  • Evaluate vendors and tools, build business cases, and make clear recommendations on build versus buy tradeoffs
  • Design environments that support global care and operations teams, including secure and efficient remote computing setups
  • Contribute to the IT roadmap and communicate priorities, risks, and progress to technical and business stakeholders

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a clear, documented architecture and standards for identity, endpoint, and SaaS management that the team can build on
  • Delivered at least one major platform initiative, such as a zero-trust access model or endpoint modernization, with measurable gains in security posture and employee experience
  • Reduced manual IT work through automation and infrastructure as code, with a measurable drop in recurring ticket volume
  • Strengthened audit readiness, contributing to clean results on security and compliance reviews
  • Raised the technical capability of the team through mentorship, documentation, and shared standards
  • Built trusted partnerships with Information Security, People, Engineering, and Finance

About You

You likely have:

  • 6+ years of experience in IT systems engineering, endpoint engineering, or infrastructure roles, including ownership of production platforms
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with identity and access platforms such as Okta, including SSO, SCIM, lifecycle automation, and conditional access
  • Expert-level experience managing Mac and Windows fleets with JAMF and Intune, including packaging, deployment, security policy, and compliance enforcement
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, Bash, or PowerShell), with experience using APIs and source-controlled configuration
  • Experience designing and implementing security controls, such as encryption, vulnerability management, and zero-trust principles, in partnership with Security teams
  • A track record of leading cross-functional technical projects from design through rollout without direct authority
  • Experience mentoring or technically guiding other engineers
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex tradeoffs for executive and non-technical audiences

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or another regulated environment (for example, HIPAA or SOC 2)
  • Experience with infrastructure as code and CI/CD practices applied to endpoint or SaaS configuration
  • Hands-on experience with AWS or GCP and modern cloud networking concepts
  • Experience designing remote computing environments for call center or clinical operations teams, such as VDI or managed browser models
  • Experience building AI-assisted workflows or tooling to improve IT operations
  • Relevant certifications (for example JAMF Certified Expert, Okta Certified Professional, or Microsoft Endpoint Administrator)

Why This Role Matters

Every Carrot employee depends on technology that is secure, reliable, and easy to use, whether they are supporting members through deeply personal care journeys or partnering with global employers. This role sets the technical foundation that makes that possible.

As Carrot continues to scale across geographies and functions, the architecture and standards you establish will protect member trust, strengthen our security posture, and give the business the speed and confidence to keep growing.

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

  • Base Salary Range: $150,000 – $175,000 (primary range).
  • Geo-Tier Adjustment: Up to $190,000 for highly experienced candidates within 50 miles of San Francisco, NYC, or Seattle.

Actual compensation may vary from the posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

title: DevOps Engineer, Edge and Developer Experience (Remote Eligible in Bulgaria)
description: Headquarters: -REMOTE, BULGARIA- For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day. We are seeking a DevOps Engineer II to join the Edge and Developer Experience team. Our team collaboratively operates Smartsheet's high-performance edge proxy platform and drives the adoption of internal engineering tooling. The edge proxy serves as the entry point for all traffic across Smartsheet's commercial and FedRAMP-authorized US Government environments. The team supports the lifecycle of this platform: from maintaining proxy configurations, to provisioning the multi-region AWS EKS infrastructure it runs on, to assisting with observability. Beyond the edge layer, the team also drives the integration of internal developer tooling — from а developer portal (IDP) to standardized CI/CD pipelines — that improves the engineering experience and velocity across the company. You will work remotely from Bulgaria and report to one of our engineering leaders in Bulgaria. You will: Contribute to the edge proxy platform: Assist in maintaining, upgrading, and extending a high-performance reverse proxy. This includes writing Go and Python automation, managing container images on hardened Linux bases, and working with CDN and traffic management capabilities. Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code: Implement Terraform/Terragrunt modules and live environment configurations for EKS clusters, load balancers, IAM roles, and supporting AWS services. Operate Kubernetes clusters: Assist in managing multi-region EKS deployments via GitOps workflows (e.g., FluxCD, ArgoCD) and Helm charts. Support CI/CD pipelines: Help design, maintain, and improve shared GitLab CI/CD pipeline templates used across team repositories, embedding DevSecOps guardrails. Automate operational toil: Build tooling for tasks such as container image patching, EKS AMI rotation, and automated patching cycles. Manage observability: Help provision and maintain Datadog SLOs, monitors, and dashboards; participate in the team's on-call rotation responding to incidents. Support Developer Experience initiatives: Assist in the rollout and integration of various platforms to reduce cognitive load for engineering teams. Apply AI tools: Leverage AI-based workflows within your domain to improve project execution, infrastructure design, and debugging. You Have: 2–4 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, or Site Reliability Engineering. A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Hands-on experience with Terraform for managing cloud infrastructure. Experience with Kubernetes operations and AWS services (EKS, VPC, IAM, ECR). Proficiency in at least one general-purpose programming language — Go or Python preferred — for building operational automation. Experience designing or maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI/CD preferred). Familiarity with container image security practices and GitOps workflows. A strong operational mindset with a willingness to participate in on-call rotations and incident response. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Fluency in English is required. Familiarity with leveraging AI-based workflows to author or maintain code/infrastructure. Legally eligible to work in Bulgaria on an ongoing basis. Nice to Have: Understanding of reverse proxies, API gateways, or load balancers (NGINX, HAProxy, or equivalent). Familiarity with FedRAMP or AWS GovCloud operational constraints. Experience managing Datadog resources via infrastructure as code. Experience integrating internal developer portals or feature flag management tools. Smartsheet provides a competitive base salary range for roles that may be hired in different geographic areas we are licensed to operate our business from. Actual compensation is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, level of professional, educational experience, skills, and specific candidate location. In addition, this role will be eligible for a market-competitive incentive opportunity. Get to Know Us: At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together. Equal Opportunity Employer: Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. title: IAM Software Engineer
description:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

title: Stage of Afstuderen: Optimalisatie van Machine-inspecties
description: Wat ga je doen? Binnen Customer Service voert Voortman periodieke machine-inspecties uit om de technische staat van machines te beoordelen en klanten te adviseren over onderhoud, reparaties en mogelijke verbeteringen. Deze inspecties vormen een belangrijke basis voor het verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid, prestaties en levensduur van machines. Het huidige inspectieproces is door de jaren heen organisch gegroeid. Hierdoor worden inspectievragen niet altijd op dezelfde manier geïnterpreteerd, verschillen beoordelingen tussen monteurs en worden bevindingen niet overal uniform vastgelegd. Ook de rapportage richting klanten kan op onderdelen duidelijker, consistenter en meer actiegericht worden ingericht. title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
description: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness. In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes. This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on. What you'll do Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down. Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan. raw.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine – Query Engine
raw.description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll own the query engine that searches hundreds of billions of claims across a variety of retrieval backends, from a distributed graph database to vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial indexes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. No off-the-shelf system answers precise questions over hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims at agent speed, so you'll make foundational decisions, from storage layout and indexing across engines to the query language and the planner that routes work between them, that every query depends on.

What you'll do

  • Own storage and indexing across backends: data layout, partitioning and indexes for graph, vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval, with bulk snapshot builds and live ingest that never take the system down.

  • Decide how best to search: cost-based planning from cardinality estimates that chooses, for each question, which backends to use, in what order and how to join their results, executed as traversals, retrievals, filters and aggregations in one plan.

  • Make it fast at scale: serve thousands of queries per second, profiling and cutting p50/p99 latency, memory and cost per query under high concurrent load, from on-disk layout to network fan-out.

  • Keep answers consistent while the data converges: the graph is fed by live updates and bulk snapshots at once and is eventually consistent by design, so you'll own what a query may see while it converges: consistent snapshot promotion, ordered application of live updates and stable pagination across versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: end-to-end checks every deployment must pass, plus evals and metrics that show when a plan returns wrong results or misses ones it should have found.

What we're looking for

  • You've worked deep inside a distributed database, query engine, search engine or storage system.

  • Strong grasp of indexing, query planning and optimization, and storage formats.

  • Solid grasp of distributed systems fundamentals: consensus, replication, sharding and fault tolerance.

  • Strong in a systems language (Go, Rust or C++).

  • You profile before you optimize, and you've shipped measured latency wins in production.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Graph databases, or combining vector, full-text, time-series and geospatial retrieval

  • Compilers, query language design or cost-based optimizers

Example projects

  • Build a system that retrieves and reasons over everything known about any company or person in the world, answering any factual question precisely and completely.

  • Answer precise multi-hop questions over hundreds of billions of claims at thousands of QPS with interactive latency.

  • Build a planner that picks the right mix of graph, vector, full-text and geospatial retrieval for any question, and proves it chose well.

  • Make new knowledge queryable seconds after it's synthesized, without ever serving an inconsistent result.

raw.jobDescription:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets by automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners—specifically in cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audits. We build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We're based in San Francisco, CA, and built remote-first. We're backed by Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, and more. Over 50 of the top 100 accounting and consulting firms trust Fieldguide to power mission-critical work.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide's team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

About the Role

You'll join a genuine 0→1 team on the ground floor of one of the company's biggest new bets. You will work full-stack on long-horizon agents, ship features that do real audit work, and work alongside practitioners.

Depending on your experience and what you're looking to own, you may join building within a major agent area, owning one end-to-end, or setting technical direction for agentic audit work across the team. We're hiring across all levels and will calibrate during interviews based on scope and demonstrated experience.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agent-driven experiences for SOX control testing, deciding where autonomy makes sense and where the auditor stays in the loop

  • Own complex, end-to-end workstreams across the full stack

  • Make long agentic runs trustworthy: improve reliability, repeatability, performance, and observability so the same evidence produces the same defensible conclusion every time

  • Turn agent output into finished audit deliverables, including structured workpapers that adapt to whatever template a firm brings

  • Ship code from day one and ramp quickly into full ownership of significant product areas

  • Collaborate daily with product managers, designers, and SOX subject matter experts to work through difficult domain problems

  • Help shape technical direction and contribute to how the team thinks about agentic systems, AI tooling, and engineering best practices

Who You Are (All Levels)

  • A strong full-stack engineer who writes code every day and wants to continue doing so

  • You've built with LLMs in production, not just in prototypes. You know what breaks when real users and real documents hit an agent

  • Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you figure things out as you go

  • Energized by 0→1 work: you'd rather define the problem than inherit a spec

  • High degree of ownership; you don't wait to be told what to do

  • A genuine team player across the organization, not just within engineering. You'll work directly with PM, design, domain experts, and customer-facing teams, and you treat that as the best part of the job

  • Able to pick up complex domain concepts quickly. You don't need to know SOX or internal controls, but you're the kind of person who can internalize it fast

  • Already using AI coding tools in your workflow and curious about where agentic approaches create real leverage

Higher-Level Responsibilities

At the Senior level, you may:

  • Lead complex projects or systems, setting technical direction and ensuring long-term health

  • Collaborate with PMs and designers to shape roadmaps and define architectural tradeoffs

  • Serve as a domain expert within one or more technical areas (e.g., agent orchestration, evaluation and quality, document processing, frontend architecture)

  • Mentor other engineers and help raise the technical bar across the team

At the Staff level, you may:

  • Drive company-level technical initiatives and influence cross-team architecture

  • Set and champion engineering standards for scalability, security, and performance

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to define long-term technical strategy

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Engineering, Product, and Design

  • Represent Fieldguide externally through writing, speaking, and open-source contributions

Experience

Must-have:

  • Shipped LLM-backed product features to production against real users

  • Comfortable full-stack, with enough backend depth to work in agent orchestration

  • Autonomy working from an ambiguous spec

  • A collaborative mindset with an ability to work across PM, design, and domain experts

  • Willingness to develop an Applied AI skillset including writing evals, using LLM observability tools, and being thoughtful about quality

Nice-to-have:

  • Startup experience, as a founder or as an early engineer

  • A track record of 0→1 projects you took from nothing to something people use

  • Experience working directly with customers, and comfort being in the room when they use what you built

  • Experience in internal audit, SOX, financial services, accounting, or compliance

  • Familiarity with our stack: TypeScript, React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Python, and Temporal

  • Experience with document processing, PDF/Excel manipulation, or evaluation frameworks for model output

Not a fit if:

  • You’re not interested in deeply learning about Agents

  • You’ve never built a product to scale

  • You need a fully specified ticket to start

  • You'd rather not be in the room with customers and domain experts

What Should Excite You

  • 0→1 on the biggest bet: You're building the agent and the product from scratch, on the ground floor of where the company is going

  • Real audit stakes: Your work directly affects what firms put in front of their clients, and what a reviewer is willing to sign

  • Customer proximity: Design-partner firms and an embedded SOX expert use what you ship within days of it landing

  • High trust, high autonomy: You're given ambiguous problems and trusted to define the plan

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation with equity

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits

  • Flexible time off and work schedules

  • Technology reimbursements

  • 401(k) plan

  • Twice-yearly in-person offsites across the U.S.

  • Wellness benefits starting on your first day

Our Values

  • Fearless — Inspire and break down seemingly impossible walls

  • Fast — Launch fast with excellence; iterate to perfection

  • Lovable — Deliver happiness and 11-star experiences

  • Owners — Execute and run the business with ownership

  • Win-win — Create mutual value and earn trust for life

  • Inclusive — Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams

raw.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in San Francisco to join our team and to help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You’ll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you’re equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why this role matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers, 1,000+ OSS contributors, and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

  • Make content

    Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

  • Build demos and tutorials

    Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

  • Represent Supabase

    Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

  • Support and grow the community

    Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

  • Collaborate across the company

    Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

  • You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

  • You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

  • You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

  • You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

  • You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

  • Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

  • Experience creating technical content (written or video)

  • Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

  • A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

  • Prior experience in DevRel or open source

  • Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

title: Senior IT Engineer
description:
Who we are

Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.

About the role

At Typeform, we believe technology should make work simpler, smarter and more human.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer to help shape the future of IT at Typeform. Someone who combines strong technical expertise with a passion for automation, AI and building better ways of working.

This isn't just about keeping systems running. It's about rethinking how IT operates.

You'll play a key role in building an AI first, service led IT function, improving how we manage internal technology, support our people and automate everyday processes.

Working within a small, high impact team, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of meaningful projects, influence our technology roadmap and help us move from reactive support towards smarter, more proactive IT operations.

What you'll do

Own and improve our IT operations

  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex IT incidents, requests and technical challenges, taking ownership through to resolution.
  • Help maintain secure, reliable and scalable internal technology systems.
  • Apply ITIL best practices across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Improve service performance, documentation, operational processes and the overall employee experience.
  • Work closely with the wider IT team to balance daily support with longer term engineering projects.

Build smarter systems through AI and automation

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve workflows across IT.
  • Design and implement AI powered solutions that improve service delivery, productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Improve employee onboarding, offboarding, access management and software lifecycle processes.
  • Use APIs, integrations, scripting and automation tools to connect systems and remove unnecessary manual work.
  • Explore emerging AI technologies and turn promising ideas into practical solutions, with appropriate security and governance.

Think like a product owner

  • Take ownership of specific IT services and capabilities, from identifying problems through to delivering improvements.
  • Work with stakeholders to understand their needs and prioritise improvements based on business impact.
  • Build and maintain clear roadmaps and project backlogs.
  • Measure the success of improvements through service quality, efficiency, reliability and employee experience.
  • Lead technical changes, migrations and improvements with clear communication, risk management and planning.

Collaborate across Typeform

  • Partner with Security, People, Finance, Procurement and Engineering to deliver secure and effective technology solutions.
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.
  • Share knowledge, improve documentation and support the development of other IT team members.
  • Help create a culture of ownership, continuous improvement and experimentation.

What you'll bring

  • Strong experience in corporate IT engineering, systems engineering or IT service management within a modern SaaS or technology company.
  • ITIL certification and practical experience applying ITIL principles across incident, change, problem and service management.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues across corporate IT systems, identity, access, devices, applications and integrations.
  • Strong hands on experience with modern IT environments, particularly Apple devices, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack and Atlassian.
  • Experience building automation using APIs, scripting, integrations or workflow automation tools.
  • Practical experience using AI to improve IT operations, support processes or internal productivity.
  • Experience improving employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, provisioning and access management.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to take ownership of technical challenges from investigation through to resolution.
  • A product mindset, with experience prioritising improvements, managing stakeholders and delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across technical and business teams.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI driven IT workflows or introducing AI into internal service operations.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, intelligent workflow orchestration and knowledge management systems.
  • Experience integrating HR, identity, finance, asset management and IT service platforms.
  • Experience building internal tooling, dashboards or operational reporting.
  • Exposure to security, compliance, endpoint management and IT governance.
  • Experience leading technology migrations or large internal systems improvement projects.

*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We move as one team, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters strong bonds grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. title: EDA/CAD Engineer
description: At Kandou , we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption. Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient . Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale. Kandou’s architecture is not just an incremental improvement — it’s a foundational shift in how AI hardware is built for the future. We are actively seeking an EDA/CAD Engineer, based either in UK (Cambridge or Reading), Switzerland (St-Sulpice), or India (Hyderabad or Bangalore) Department: RnD Key Responsibilities Manage and maintain an integrated analog/digital EDA environment, including installation, configuration, and support of tools such as Cadence Virtuoso, Synopsys platforms, and Siemens Calibre/AFS. Flow development & automation: design, automate, and validate robust CAD flows for simulation, physical verification, parasitic extraction, and reliability analysis. Methodology support: provide expert guidance to analog and digital design engineers; troubleshoot tool issues; optimize design methodologies for performance and quality. Vendor management: serve as the primary technical contact with EDA vendors to resolve complex issues, drive bug fixes, and evaluate new versions/features. PDK installation & support: contribute to installation, qualification, and deployment of PDKs for advanced technology nodes. Design enablement: create and maintain clear documentation, training materials, and scripts so teams can use tools and flows effectively. Continuous improvement: proactively identify bottlenecks and implement solutions that improve productivity, accuracy, and turnaround time. Skills Strong programming skills: Shell, Python, Perl, Tcl, SKILL; ability to develop simple GUIs; Make-based build automation. Solid understanding of the full chip-design lifecycle and digital, analog, and mixed‑signal IC design flows. Strong communication and interpersonal skills; collaborates effectively with engineering teams and vendors. Excellent problem‑solving skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast‑paced environment. Proficient in EDA/CAD flow development while balancing stakeholder needs (quality, schedule, and compute efficiency). Ability to quickly learn, understand, maintain, and enhance complex software design tools. Experience Bachelor or Master of Science Degree, in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science. 10+ years in an EDA/CAD engineering supporting both analog and digital IC design teams. Proven experience at advanced technology nodes and associated PDKs. Practical knowledge of industry-standard methodologies, tool licensing, revision control, and release management. Hands-on expertise with key tools across: Analog/RF (Cadence Virtuoso Schematic/Layout, ADE, Spectre/APS/AFS), Physical Verification (Siemens Calibre; Cadence Pegasus), Parasitic Extraction (Cadence Quantus), and Digital Implementation (Synopsys Design Compiler & IC Compiler II; Cadence Innovus). Proven experience at advanced technology nodes and associated PDKs. Practical knowledge of industry-standard methodologies, tool licensing, revision control, and release management. Deep data management experience (Git, Cliosoft) enabling consistent, flexible multi‑project/multi‑discipline flow setup and database tagging. If this is the role you have been looking for and want to be part of a growing company with an exciting future, we would really love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It! Visit us at www.kandou.ai and https://www.linkedin.com/company/kandou-ai/ Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: IAM Software Engineer
description:
As an IAM Software Engineer, you’ll focus on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions. Your work combines technical analysis, platform configuration, low-code implementation, integration, testing, and troubleshooting, with custom coding where needed. You’ll work closely with engineers, architects, consultants, and customer teams to deliver secure, reliable solutions. 

You’ll join an engineering delivery team of around 8–12 people, working across customer assignments in two-week sprints, often with a specific sprint focus. Our ‘you build it, you run it’ approach combines implementation, ongoing improvement, and troubleshooting after delivery, supported by senior engineers in your own and neighbouring teams doing similar work. 

What you’ll do as an IAM Software Engineer 

  • Design and deliver IGA solutions that help customers govern access, using standard platform capabilities, low-code tools, and integration standards, with C#, SQL, and APIs where needed. 
  • Translate customer needs into technical designs and engineering tasks, working with architects, security engineers, and customer stakeholders to meet security, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements. 
  • Troubleshoot complex IAM issues, identify root causes, and implement lasting improvements that reduce recurrence and security risk. 
  • Improve automation and delivery practices, using PowerShell and CI/CD where appropriate to make implementation and ongoing changes more reliable. 
  • Share knowledge and support junior engineers through mentoring, design sessions, and reviews of configurations, integrations, and code. 

The impact you’ll have 

Your engineering work will help leading organizations manage access confidently, protect sensitive data, and comply with evolving regulations. By building reliable IAM solutions and improving delivery practices, you’ll contribute to technical strategy and help the team deliver more effectively—strengthening client security and trust in the digital landscape. 

What we can offer you 

Autonomy in your work and support for your career development. 

  • Permanent, full-time contract (40 hours per week) 
  • Flexible, hybrid working: typically two days per week on location—one at a client site and one at our Waardenburg office. 
  • Work outside normal hours is rare (currently fewer than five occasions per year) and always discussed in advance. 
  • Typically, 5–15 learning days per year for your development, including certifications and events. Training and associated costs are agreed individually rather than through a fixed training budget. 
  • 30 days of annual leave: 25 flexible days and 5 fixed company days. 
  • Variable team bonus and annual profit distribution 
  • Mobility budget or company lease car 
  • Private pension scheme 
  • Home office setup budget and monthly remote work allowance 
  • Regular team and company social events 

What you’ll bring to the team 

Core experience and skills 

  • 3–6 years in software or platform engineering, including at least one year designing and implementing IGA solutions such as Omada Identity or Microsoft Entra ID Governance. 
  • Experience in solution design, configuration, API integration, testing, and deployment, using Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps). 
  • Practical C# and SQL experience to troubleshoot and extend IAM solutions where needed. 
  • Strong analytical, design, and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software security and the ability to turn security and compliance requirements into practical solutions. 
  • A relevant bachelor’s degree (e.g., computer science or information security), or equivalent experience. 

How you work 

  • Strong collaboration, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with a structured, proactive approach and the ability to drive work independently. 

Practical requirements 

  • English at C1 and Dutch at B2 or higher, written and spoken. 
  • Client-site travel is within the Netherlands, with current major clients in the Randstad. You’re able and willing to travel to those sites and our Waardenburg office; no driver’s license is required. 
  • Currently residing in the Netherlands and eligible to work here. 

Nice to have 

  • Azure experience. 
  • AI-assisted tools for analysis, configuration, testing, documentation, or coding. 
  • Relevant certifications, e.g., Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Omada Certified Engineer, or CISSP. 

About SITS | Traxion 

SITS | Traxion specializes in Identity & Access Management, with 24 years of consulting experience and a team of 120 specialists. We work with organizations across sectors, including Schiphol Group, dsm-firmenich, Gemeente Rotterdam, Belastingdienst, E.ON, and Ayvens. 

As part of the European IT security group SITS, we combine international collaboration with a flat organizational structure and a respectful, collaborative culture. 

 

Ready to make an impact and secure Europe’s digital identities? Apply today!
Interested but have questions before applying? Contact to learn more about the role and whether it matches your experience. 

 

At SITS | Traxion, we believe diversity strengthens our teams and fosters innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of gender, background, or experience, can thrive.

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • condition

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

Interview Process

  1. Take-home assignment submission (as described above).

  2. Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style).

  3. 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership.

How to apply

Email your portfolio, GitHub repository, and as an optional bonus, 1-2 other relevant projects to techjobs@fluencetraining.com, along with a short note on a security/privacy consideration you implemented (or would implement) in a healthcare or similar context.
