  • Work closely with product managers and designers to craft compelling user experiences
  • Collaborate with a wide range of teams from Ad Formats to Ad Delivery to ensure successful end-to-end delivery of product ads
  • Establish and manage to SLAs within your team
  • Be a strong mentor and cross-functional advocate for your team
  • Contribute meaningfully to team strategy. We give everyone a seat at the table and encourage active participation in planning for the future. Don’t just come along for the ride.

Required Qualifications:

Do work that matters.

At AlertMedia, we help organizations protect their people, operations, and brand. Our modern Risk Intelligence and Response platform empowers teams to detect emerging threats, assess impact, and respond with confidence. We believe building resilience should be simpler—and it starts with bringing critical information and workflows together in one unified platform.

Our core values drive us in our important mission of keeping people safe & informed:

  • We’re humans not robots
  • Customers always come first
  • We work better together
  • Simplicity is our strength
  • Our reputation is priceless
  • Hard work pays off

As one of the fastest-growing software companies in the country, AlertMedia is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer with full-stack experience. This role is on our AI Agent and Orchestration team, building the AI Assistant and Orchestration products and the agents and platform capabilities that power them. As an AI-forward company, we actively use modern AI tools such as Claude, Codex, and other emerging technologies to help our engineers work smarter, move faster, and build better products. 

Who you are: 

You thrive in a collaborative engineering environment that plays to everyone's strengths with a willingness to work across the entire stack. You’ve developed scalable production web applications in Python/Django/Next.js/React. You understand how LLM applications work — context, tool calling, evaluation, and the ways they fail. You care about the quality of your work, the impactful product you help build, and the team you help build it with. You have AWS (or other cloud) experience and are willing to learn from people with both more and less experience than you. You are a user of AI-assisted development tools that improve engineering workflows, code quality, and team productivity. 

What you get to do every day: 

  • Build and ship features for the AI Assistant and Orchestration products — agents, tools, and the approval steps that gate them
  • Add eval cases for the AI behavior you build, so prompt and model changes that degrade quality are caught before release
  • Learn the AlertMedia platform and tools, and its uses for our customers 
  • Work with Python, Django, Next.js, React, Node and other web technologies 
  • Use AI-enabled tools such as Claude, Codex, and other emerging platforms to support development, problem-solving, documentation, and productivity 
  • Work in an Agile based environment using tools like Git, JIRA, Jenkins, and Slack 
  • Contribute to the technology lead that AlertMedia has over other solutions through innovative development and by helping contribute new ideas related to leveraging technology in our product line 
  • Use strong verbal and written communication skills in collaboration with other engineering and product teams 
  • Contribute to AlertMedia’s culture, values and vision for the future 

What you bring to the role: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field such as computer science, computer engineering or related field preferred 
  • 6+ years of experience building scalable web applications, Python/Django/React/Node tech stack preferred
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features — agents, tool/function calling, MCP or similar integrations, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation 
  • Familiar with agentic design patterns and frameworks (Strands, AutoGen, LangChain, etc.)
  • Experience with Amazon Web Services (or other cloud services) is required 
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, and other storage technologies experience required 
  • You have an established practice of writing unit and integration tests 
  • Proficiency using AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, Codex, or similar) across the development lifecycle 
  • Collaborative mindset to partner with principal engineers and leadership to drive architectural evolution for a critical application 
  • Experience troubleshooting and remediating production issues when they arise
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage working on multiple projects in parallel 
  • The ability and desire to work in a fast-paced challenging environment 
  • Outstanding communication skills and ability to effectively work cross-functionally in a fast-paced challenging environment 
  • Strong English proficiency (written and oral) is required 

Location: This role is remote in Mexico. We do have a Mexico City office in the Reforma area if you'd like to go into the office and collaborate with our engineering team, otherwise it is a fully remote position based in Mexico.

Sponsorship: AlertMedia does not sponsor candidates. Must have the legal right to work in Mexico without sponsorship now and in the future.

Why you’ll love working at AlertMedia:

  • Competitive Base Salary (Bi-Monthly payroll)
  • Annual Company Bonus
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Parental Leave Program
  • Christmas Bonus (Aguinaldo)
  • Generous Vacation and Holiday Policy
  • Additional Vacation Bonus
  • Monthly Work-from-Home Stipend
  • All Necessary Equipment Provided: Laptop, monitor and accessories
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins big and small
  • Language Immersion Program with employees spread out across the globe (English, Spanish, etc...depending on your interest)
  • Continuous Learning & Growth: From mentorship and tech talks to personalized 1:1 career development sessions, we’re deeply committed to investing in your professional journey
  • Award Winning Culture: We're proud to be recognized as a BEST WORKPLACE FOR 10 YEARS IN A ROW
  • The Work & People: We’re passionate about the meaningful work we do—and even more grateful for the incredible people we get to do it with!

About AlertMedia:

We are the leading risk intelligence and response platform — trusted by the largest companies in the world to protect their people and assets when it matters most. We are a high-growth, PE-backed SaaS company with more than 4,000 clients scaling rapidly across the globe. Our technology is unmatched with a unified platform, a 7+year history of AI innovation, a customer NPS of 70+, and a culture that sets us even further apart from our competition.

We are an equal opportunity employer focused on creating a collaborative and exciting place for all to work. Ensuring a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace for all people is key to our success and core to our values.   All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. 

This is an amazing opportunity to be part of our wave of momentum and take our company, and your career, to the next growth stage. We'd love to get to know you better and share how we serve our amazing customers. For more information, please visit www.alertmedia.com.  

Come join us in our mission to save lives and minimize loss through effective communication.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning (Consumer Revenue)
description: Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games. We're looking to hire a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on our Consumer Revenue ML team. This team applies Machine Learning across Discord's core revenue surfaces — Shop, Nitro, Server Subscriptions, and Gifting — building the ranking, targeting, and recommendation systems that connect users to the right products, subscriptions, and content. If this excites you and you’ve led org-wide initiatives in the past, keep reading! What You'll Be Doing 8+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning, inclusive Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field. Strong expertise in applied deep learning and mainstream RecSys model architecture (e.g. two-tower, transformer-based models, multi-task learning). Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow. A track record of building ML systems from 0→1 in ambiguous, early-stage environments, and taking them to production at scale. Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to translate experiment results into roadmap decisions. Excellent communication and collaboration skills — able to lead cross-functional technical initiatives across multiple verticals and keep stakeholders educated and aligned. The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by open-ended, technically challenging problems. What you should have Built internal ML platform/tooling (shared data standards, targeting endpoints, recommender libraries) adopted by multiple product teams. Familiarity with personalized marketing systems — lifecycle targeting, audience segmentation and lookalikes, campaign optimization. Deep expertise in distributed training (e.g. PyTorch on GPU, Ray, Anyscale) and large-scale data processing pipelines (e.g. Chronon, Spark, Flink). This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Why Discord? Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know. title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Public Sector
description: Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows. Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson. Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations. As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design. At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey. This is a remote role that must be based in EST in the United States. About the Role You'll join as a founding member of Tines’ forward deployed team, embedded directly with our public sector and federal customers to drive transformational AI adoption. Your job is to realize maximum potential for Tines’ customers and to ensure every stakeholder from end user to customer leadership understands and fully realizes the value of Tines. You own the full arc of a customer's success: from deepening adoption and enabling stakeholders through to discovering new opportunities where the platform can create measurable business impact. You’ll show customers the art of what's possible and ensuring the value delivered today is only the beginning. You'll be the person customers trust most to make the Tines’ platform work for them in practice. We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity and represent us at the highest level inside customer environments. You'll be as comfortable deep in a customer's technical environment as you are leading a training session with a non-technical team or presenting a business case to a CTO. What you will be doing: Own end-to-end deployment: Lead the technical implementation of Tines’ platform within complex enterprise environments. Integrating with existing systems, configuring for customer-specific workflows and ensuring a fast, smooth path to deliverable outcomes. Drive adoption across the organisation: Proactively support and train users and stakeholders in the customer at every level from hands-on technical teams to business leaders ensuring the platform is understood actively used and maximized. Identify and develop new use cases: Through deep familiarity with each customer's business, continuously surface new opportunities where Tines’ platform can create additional value expanding adoption across teams, workflows, and business units. Be the primary technical point of contact: Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on all things platform-related. Troubleshooting issues, delivering workshops, answering technical questions and resolving blockers before they become problems. Maintain strong customer relationships: Build lasting partnerships at every level of the organisation, from daily users to executive sponsors with a focus on long-term retention and growth. Feed insights back to the product: Codify what you learn in the field. raw.jobDescription:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in EST in the United States.

About the Role

You'll join as a founding member of Tines’ forward deployed team, embedded directly with our public sector and federal customers to drive transformational AI adoption. Your job is to realize maximum potential for Tines’ customers and to ensure every stakeholder from end user to customer leadership understands and fully realizes the value of Tines.

You own the full arc of a customer's success: from deepening adoption and enabling stakeholders through to discovering new opportunities where the platform can create measurable business impact. You’ll show customers the art of what's possible and ensuring the value delivered today is only the beginning. You'll be the person customers trust most to make the Tines’ platform work for them in practice.

We expect our FDEs to operate autonomously, thrive in ambiguity and represent us at the highest level inside customer environments. You'll be as comfortable deep in a customer's technical environment as you are leading a training session with a non-technical team or presenting a business case to a CTO.

What you will be doing:

  • Own end-to-end deployment: Lead the technical implementation of Tines’ platform within complex enterprise environments. Integrating with existing systems, configuring for customer-specific workflows and ensuring a fast, smooth path to deliverable outcomes.
  • Drive adoption across the organisation: Proactively support and train users and stakeholders in the customer at every level from hands-on technical teams to business leaders ensuring the platform is understood actively used and maximized.
  • Identify and develop new use cases: Through deep familiarity with each customer's business, continuously surface new opportunities where Tines’ platform can create additional value expanding adoption across teams, workflows, and business units.
  • Be the primary technical point of contact: Serve as the customer's trusted advisor on all things platform-related. Troubleshooting issues, delivering workshops, answering technical questions and resolving blockers before they become problems.
  • Maintain strong customer relationships: Build lasting partnerships at every level of the organisation, from daily users to executive sponsors with a focus on long-term retention and growth.
  • Feed insights back to the product: Codify what you learn in the field. Surfacing recurring friction points, unmet needs and high-value use cases and sharing these with Tines’ internal teams such as Engineering, Product and GTM.
  • Travel 20–40% to customer sites to build trust, accelerate adoption and deepen relationships in person.

What you Bring with you:

  • 8+ years in a technical, customer-facing role: Solutions / Pre-sales Engineer, Technical Consultant, Customer Success Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration / Implementation Engineer or Software Engineer with customer exposure
  • 5+ years of experience working with public sector or federal customers
  • Proven track record of driving adoption and delivering measurable value from complex technical products inside enterprise environments
  • Strong engineering skills to own integrations, troubleshoot production issues and understand customer infrastructure
  • Strong Python skills (plus ideally TypeScript, Java, or similar)
  • Production experience with LLMs and AI systems: prompt engineering, agent workflows, and deployment at scale
  • Ability to train, enable and influence stakeholders across all levels
  • High agency and resourcefulness: you find a path forward independently, escalate only when necessary, and take full ownership of your accounts
  • Strong communication skills: clear, confident, and low-ego: you make complex things feel simple
  • Willingness to travel 20–40% to customer sites

Target Annual Compensation: $220-240K OTE (90/10 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-SW1 #LI-remote

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As a Staff Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you are a technical leader - setting technical direction, driving architectural decisions, and raising engineering quality across your team. This is a player-coach role: you lead through code and architecture, not just direction. You'll write production code as a hands-on individual contributor while owning your team's technical strategy, roadmap, and growth, and you'll collaborate closely with product, design, and QA to turn complex workflows into delightful, intuitive experiences.

We're hiring a Staff Software Engineer for the following team:

  • Treasury: Join the team building Juniper Square's Treasury platform, the system that brings transactions, balances, and bank data into and across the platform. You'll work on expanding bank integrations, a visualization and reporting layer for payments and treasury data, and vendor exports that connect treasury data to accounting, on a team that has already processed $500M+ in transactions.

What you'll do

Own Technical Direction & Architecture

  • Set the technical direction and own the architecture for your domain's systems, from design through production

  • Lead technical design for ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives - evaluating tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, and driving implementation

  • Be instrumental in your team's transition from monolith to service-oriented architecture

  • Evaluate and select technologies with a bias toward what ships well and scales sustainably

Build & Deliver

  • Write production code as a hands-on individual contributor - this is not a role that delegates implementation to others

  • Own end-to-end delivery of roadmap projects: design, coding, testing, and production

  • Manage your team's short-term roadmap (spanning the next two quarters), proactively surfacing execution, cost, and technical risks and driving pragmatic mitigation

  • Lead the development of complex, full-stack workflows, working across frontend and backend engineers

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Practice AI Fluency across the full software development lifecycle - deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool, and defending those tradeoffs against real criteria (latency, accuracy, cost, data sensitivity, explainability)

  • Champion and embed AI-native development practices and tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) to drive significant productivity gains across your team

  • Adapt code review and testing practices for an AI-assisted SDLC - catching AI-specific failure modes (hallucinated dependencies, overconfident but incorrect logic) before they ship

  • Build and evaluate agentic workflows and AI-assisted systems where they add real value, with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries and monitoring for failure

  • Guard against over-reliance on AI tooling, in your own work and in the code you review, balancing velocity with system comprehension and accountability for outcomes

  • Foster a culture of rapid iteration, high velocity, and quality, and help raise AI fluency across the team

Lead & Grow the Team

  • Mentor engineers, raise the quality of technical decision-making, and help the team execute with consistency

  • Establish coding standards, review practices, and architectural documentation that scale as the team grows

  • Partner with recruiting to build and grow the team

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and customer support to translate requirements into executable technical plans

  • Participate actively in design reviews and roadmap discussions with a grounded, implementation-level perspective

  • Handle most cross-team conflicts and technical decisions autonomously

Operational Excellence

  • Own monitoring, diagnosing, and resolving production issues within your team's services

  • Use observability tooling to measure and improve system performance and reliability

  • Implement and uphold best practices that maximize developer productivity across the team

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert in your domain, with an in-depth understanding of customer needs and the value your systems deliver

Qualifications

Required

  • 12+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering, with a clear trajectory of increasing technical leadership, architectural responsibility, and mentorship

  • A portfolio of shipped production systems - be ready to walk through specific technical decisions you personally made and code you personally wrote; this is not a role for someone whose primary contribution has been directing others

  • Deep expertise in at least one server-side language (Python preferred, Node/TS, Java, C++, C#, or similar) and strong proficiency building production-grade backend services

  • Experience with modern front-end frameworks (React preferred) and comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and data modeling

  • Experience building and operating cloud-native systems using AWS (or equivalent), Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, reliability, and operational excellence in production environments

  • Deep understanding of service-oriented architecture and experience evolving systems from monolith toward SOA

  • Demonstrated ability to raise engineering quality through technical standards, design reviews, mentoring, and reusable platform patterns

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment) and a track record of using them to accelerate personal and team velocity

  • Demonstrated AI Fluency: hands-on experience building AI-assisted or agentic systems with a deliberate, defensible point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool; adapted code review practices to catch AI-specific failure modes; and concrete safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Ability to work through ambiguity, break down complex problems, and drive alignment across engineering, product, and design

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

Nice to Have

  • Reporting: experience with data integration platforms, ETL/ELT processes, business intelligence tools, or financial data

  • Production experience building AI/LLM-powered systems (RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation frameworks)

  • Background in financial document processing or fintech data pipelines

  • Prior experience in a technical lead or TLM capacity on a new or early-stage product team

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $190,000 – $235,000 USD and the Canadian base salary range is $180,000 - $225,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

• Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

• Life insurance

• Mental wellness coverage

• Fertility and growing family support

• Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

• Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

• Retirement saving plans

• Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

• Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

title: Growth Engineer
description: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. Role Overview As Cresta’s Growth Engineer , you'll own the systems behind how Cresta shows up on the internet. In this role, you will own the technical decisions behind cresta.com and help shape how Cresta puts its own AI agents to work for marketing use cases. You'll architect and build our web platform, create the tooling that lets marketers ship without an engineer in the loop, and develop custom AI agents on Cresta's platform. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you. Responsibilities The web platform Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else. Set the technical vision for how our website stack and CMS should evolve to meet the growing needs of our business and the rapidly changing workflows of the marketing team. Our website runs on Webflow today. Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows. Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops. Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down. Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs AI Agent Creation Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team. Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience. What We’re Looking For 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering. Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred. A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to. High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close. Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers. Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived. Nice To Have Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement. Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory. Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM. Perks & Benefits: We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees Compensation at Cresta: Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table. Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity. Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K + Equity Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.   • Own how cresta.com is built end to end: how it’s structured, how content flows through it, and how it connects to everything else.

  • Partner with brand and design on the interactive experiences that carry our identity. They set the creative vision; you architect and build it. Own the component system so the site stays consistent as it grows.
  • Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack — forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution — so data lands cleanly downstream, in partnership with marketing ops.
  • Build the technical foundation for localization as we scale into new markets, including locale routing, URL architecture, and hreflang, partnering with our web strategy lead on CMS translation workflows and content structure
  • Put in the engineering practices that let us move quickly without breaking things. Enough to ship with confidence, not so much that it slows us down.
  • Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs

AI Agent Creation

  • Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta's platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.
  • Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.
  • Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.

  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You've been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.
  • High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.
  • Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.
  • Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

title: Solution Integrations Architect - Oracle
description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role We’re looking for a Solution Integrations Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the Oracle ecosystem. As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems. You Will You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization. Architect & standardize Oracle R12 integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core Oracle EBS R12 integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations. Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs. Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets. Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments. Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing Oracle EBS, P2P, and financial systems expertise to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right. Qualifications 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with Oracle EBS or Oracle environments. Strong foundational knowledge of core Oracle EBS business processes, schema layouts, and data models, specifically within Oracle Purchasing (PO), Payables (AP), and General Ledger (GL). Familiarity with standard Oracle EBS integration methods, including Open Interface Tables, Public APIs/PL-SQL Packages, Oracle Integrated SOA Gateway (ISG), and REST/SOAP services. Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly. Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols. Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required. Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. Comfortable working with API documentation. Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. Strong communication skills. Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive. Experience working with product and engineering teams. Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement. Perks & Benefits At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. Start-up equity Health, vision & dental coverage ️ Catered lunches & dinners for TO employees Team building events & happy hours Flexible PTO Apple equipment plus home office budget We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. The role

Our CloudGate team is responsible for the software side of external network connectivity in our Cloud. We're building a traffic delivery system for a variety of scenarios: IPv4 connectivity, Cloud Interconnect, Egress NAT, and a network load balancer. They serve tens of millions of packets per second.

We have a control plane microservice architecture with gRPC transport and our own Database as our data warehouse.

What we do:

  • Increase service scalability
  • Developing service functionality with support for service endpoints and expansion of health check types
  • Improve the internal architecture, optimizing interaction with related services

In this position, your responsibility will be to:

  • Developing a data plane for Nebius Cloud network services
  • Improve service performance and reliability
  • Automate complex cross-service interaction scenarios
  • Perform load testing for services

We expect you to have:

  • Capable of writing reliable, high-performance code
  • Proficient in C and ready to learn Go/C++
  • Familiar with routing network traffic

It would be an added bonus if you had:

  • Worked with VPP, DPDK, and the Linux kernel network subsystem
  • Well-versed in virtual networks and overlays, SDN, NFV, DPI, network protocols, routing and tunneling, BGP, and MPL

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

#LI-JS1

title: Full-Stack Engineer (Frontend Leaning) - Studio
description: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role You’ll build the tools that make Studio a video editor people want to live in. These include transitions, color grading and elements libraries all built on top of our in-house engine. You’ll also build presets, so a user can get the effect they want without tweaking 20 individual controls. The work mixes greenfield features with polish on the existing editor. An example of the polish is letting editors coming from Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro rebind their keyboard shortcuts in one step. You’ll write proposals, get fast feedback, and own features through launch, including the marketing moment. You’re a product-minded, frontend-leaning full-stack engineer. Deep backend skills aren’t required. Requirements Strong frontend engineer who has built complex, interactive UIs. Enough full-stack ability to work across the stack, but deep backend expertise isn’t needed. Evidence of product responsibility: side projects, open source, or product-facing work. Thrives in a fast-moving, startup-style environment, and takes ownership with minimal hand-holding. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

The YDB Development Team at Nebius is hiring mid- and senior-level software developers with C++ expertise.

YDB is an open-source platform with two roles within Nebius:

  • Providing the binary object storage foundation for S3 Object Storage, Shared Filesystems and Network Block Storage
  • Serving as a distributed relational database and message broker for services such as IAM, billing, audit trails and logging

We operate YDB clusters in more than 10 regions using HDD and NVMe storage. Individual clusters span tens of thousands of nodes, manage hundreds of petabytes of data and deliver terabytes per second of throughput. Our infrastructure includes x86 and Arm-based systems, including NVIDIA GB300 nodes.

What you’ll work on

  • Evolve YDB’s architecture for new hardware, redesigning core components when incremental optimization is insufficient:
    • QLC NVMe drives: increase storage density while controlling RAM/CPU consumption and write amplification
    • Dual 800 Gb/s network adapters: reduce CPU overhead and memory bandwidth consumption to utilize the available NIC bandwidth
    • NVIDIA GB300-based systems: ensure efficient operation on Arm-based hosts and offload storage and networking processing to BlueField DPUs
  • Support high-capacity SMR HDDs by designing data placement, sequential writes, garbage collection and recovery around zoned-write constraints
  • Develop wide erasure-coding schemes to reduce space aplimfication while maintaining durability and availability
  • Reduce recovery and rebalancing times after device outages while limiting the impact on foreground workloads
  • Prevent, detect and recover from silent data corruption across memory, networking and storage
  • Provide the system capabilities and interfaces required by fleet-wide automation so that hundreds of production clusters can be deployed, configured, upgraded, diagnosed and operated consistently

We move quickly and focus on delivering practical value. Features and optimizations merged into the production branch are typically deployed within weeks. You’ll see your work solving real problems in live clusters—not waiting years to make an impact.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of professional experience developing high-load systems in C or C++. Candidates with 3+ years will also be considered if their experience includes relevant work on distributed storage systems
  • Experience developing high-performance, low-latency software components
  • Understanding of core dumps, flame graphs and sanitizer-enabled builds
  • Understanding of CPU caches, atomic operations and NUMA architectures

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing and developing production-grade distributed storage systems and/or databases
  • Experience with on-disk data structures such as LSM trees and B+ trees, and storage algorithms such as erasure coding and checksumming
  • Understanding of NVMe, conventional HDD and SMR HDD internals
  • Experience with debugging and profiling tools such as perf, VTune, bpftrace and gdb
  • Familiarity with the Linux kernel, SPDK/DPDK, libaio and io_uring
  • Knowledge of IP, TCP, UDP and DNS, and ideally InfiniBand or RoCE/RDMA
  • Experience with Kubernetes and Grafana
  • Experience responding to production incidents
  • Knowledge of availability and durability calculations

For Senior candidates, we offer hybrid working or the flexibility to work remotely within EU.

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible. We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the rendering infrastructure of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on loading modern web pages in a browser that we patch and build ourselves, so that content is rendered completely and reliably at a cost that works across billions of pages. You will work inside Chromium to remove what we do not need, make the rest faster and cheaper, and keep our build current as Chromium moves. Your work ensures that high-quality content is consistently available to the indexing and retrieval systems downstream.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Change Chromium in its heavy core (Blink, the V8 integration, the compositor, the network service) to cut CPU, memory and startup cost per page
  • Strip Chromium down for agent workloads: skip what nobody needs, such as image and media decoding, web font downloads, and rasterization and GPU work where no one needs pixels, while keeping what page scripts depend on to run correctly (style, layout, animation frames, observers), and work out what breaks, or renders differently, when you do
  • Keep the browser compatible with the web: make sure that what we remove does not change how the sites we load behave or render
  • Profile and tune fleets of browsers: the process model, memory per renderer, startup, isolation and crash handling
  • Build the production system around it: how browsers are launched, pooled, recycled and monitored

You may be a good fit if you

Have 5+ years of experience building production systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas.

Inside the browser

  • Strong C++ in a large, performance-critical codebase, ideally Chromium, Blink or V8, or a comparable browser engine (Rust is a plus)
  • Chromium architecture: the process model, Mojo IPC, the rendering pipeline (DOM, style, layout, paint, compositing), and the network service
  • Building, debugging and shipping custom Chromium builds: the build system, tracing, crash analysis, and maintaining patches across releases

Performance and systems

  • Profiling CPU, memory and I/O for browser fleets, with tools such as perf, tracing and flame graphs
  • Linux process isolation and resource management, concurrency, and memory management
  • Have run browsers in production, or built the infrastructure that does, and can describe where the time and memory went

Strong candidates may also have experience with

  • Contributions to Chromium, Blink, V8, Firefox, WebKit or another browser engine
  • Building or maintaining a patched browser that you wrote the patches for
  • Browser instrumentation, including the Chrome DevTools Protocol
  • Working familiarity with how modern frontend frameworks render (SSR, CSR, streaming, hydration)
  • Distributed systems, Kubernetes, and Go or Python

The kind of problems you will work on

  • Cut the cost of loading a page in half. Where do CPU and memory go, and what would you change in the browser?
  • Turn off the GPU and image decoding for agent workloads. What breaks, and what changes in how pages load and render?
  • A page runs a script that never yields. How do we detect and stop it without help from the page?
  • Chromium ships a new version. How do we bring a large set of patches forward in days, not weeks?
  • Decide when a page is finished, for pages with analytics beacons, long polling and endless scrolling.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership

  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

description: Headquarters: Remote • Canada About Upsun Upsun is the software factory for human-AI workflows. What to expect Identity platform: Improve our identity and access services, with Okta at the core. This includes single sign-on, automated account provisioning, multi-factor authentication, access policies, and emergency access. Work with IT and Security to make access secure, consistent, and straightforward. Google Workspace: Lead the administration and improvement of our Google Workspace environment, including users, groups, Gmail, Drive, shared drives, and security settings. Improve how people collaborate, manage sharing and access, and keep our configuration aligned with business needs. SaaS administration and governance: Administer our core internal tools and help evaluate new applications. Security and compliance: Partner with Security and the Risk and Audit team to implement and maintain controls across identity, Google Workspace, devices, and SaaS tools. Device management deployment: You have helped deploy or significantly improve an MDM or endpoint management platform. You can turn security and operational requirements into workable configurations, test them, and roll them out with minimal disruption. Automation and scripting: You build reliable automation using workflow tools, APIs, webhooks, and Python or a comparable scripting language. title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description: Headquarters: ignitionit.com URL: https://ignitionit.com Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first TL;DR ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role. We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you. What the actual job??? Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.” You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there. In a typical week, you might: Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless. Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with. Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing. Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone. Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline." ⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job. About ignitionit.com We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile! What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way. We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here. If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance. The tech you'll work with (and grow into) Day one, you'll be living in: Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more) Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends) Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling ⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open. Who we hope you are The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you: Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both) Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job. ⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who: Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine) Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application) Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously Regarding AI Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive. Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. raw.description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com
URL: https://ignitionit.com

Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first 

TL;DR

ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.

We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.

What the actual job???

Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”

You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.

In a typical week, you might:

  • Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.

  • Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.

  • Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.

  • Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.

  • Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."

⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.

About ignitionit.com

We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!

What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.

We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

If you need a rigid, fully-documented, never-changes environment where nobody trusts you with admin access, where you will be micro-managed so you never have to wonder whether or not you’re doing the right thing, this isn't it. You’ll have a ton of independence on our team, and freedom to use your best judgment to get the ball over the finish line, but that also means we expect you to be naturally responsible, honest, and highly accountable — to yourself, your teammates, and the clients. As they say, the price of freedom is eternal vigilance.

The tech you'll work with (and grow into)

Day one, you'll be living in:

  • Apple at the core — macOS, iOS, Apple Business Manager, and MDM (Jamf / Iru / Intune / Workspace ONE / and more)

  • Yes, PCs too — about one-third of our users are driving Windows

  • Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 admin consoles

  • Identity and access — SSO, MFA, and security keys (Okta, Entra ID, Yubikey, and friends)

  • Lots of other security tools — our stack is constantly evolving and may vary from client to client

  • The everyday productivity stack — Slack, Zoom, conference-room AV, networking basics (Meraki), and endpoint tooling

⠀ You don't need to know all of this. You need to be the kind of person who wants to. As you grow, there's a clear path into infrastructure administration, project architecture and implementation, and — for the right person — security and compliance work (phishing simulations, endpoint detection, SOC 2 / CIS / SEC readiness, due diligence questionnaire support, etc.). That's where our most senior people live, and it's wide open.

Who we hope you are

The hard requirements — we won't move forward unless you:

  • Can work standard business hours in Eastern or Pacific time zones (we currently need both)

  • Have a quiet home workspace and reliable broadband

  • Have proven Apple aptitude — you actually use and like the Apple ecosystem

  • Have at least 5 years of IT support experience on the job. 

⠀ Everything else — and this is the longer list, on purpose. We figure technical skills are teachable; character takes a lot longer. So we're looking for someone who:

  • Genuinely cares — about clients, teammates, and doing right by people

  • Loves to learn, and proves it in how they spend their time

  • Reads, and writes clearly — clear writing is clear thinking, and you'll do a lot of it

  • Stays calm and kind with a frustrated person on the other end of the line

  • Can tell the difference between good customer service and fantastic customer service, and refuses to settle for the former

  • Notices when something's being done inefficiently and fixes it (you may boast about it later, that’s fine)

  • Proofreads their own work (yes, we noticed whether you proofread your application)

  • Has a sense of humor, and doesn't take themselves too seriously

Regarding AI

Our company founder/CEO is headquartered in the Bay Area. We work with innovative, ambitious companies developing AI products. Our team members hold a range of opinions about whether AI is “good or bad” for humans, but at the end of the day, we embrace the plain fact that it is here, we must embrace it to evolve, and our clients increasingly depend on us to help them embrace it, too, to help them evolve and stay competitive.

Our CEO's opinion: AI will not replace human labor any time soon; rather, AI is a new opportunity to either (a) get things done faster, or (b) get a much higher quality of output than before. If you’re an AI tinkerer, great! We want to hear how you’re using it and see your latest vibe project. If you’re allergic to AI or have no interest in learning new habits to work effectively with it, this is not the place for you.

Compensation & logistics

  • Base salary: Applicants outside the USA will be compensated according to your local employment market. For applicants closer to the junior side who are located in the USA, $50,000–$65,000/yr, depending on experience level and your local geographical price index. With experience, comp goes up from there. Genuinely experienced, more senior candidates can be slotted higher — let's talk. 

  • Type & location: Full-time, work from home, fully remote. Eastern or Pacific time zones.

  • Benefits: Medical / dental / vision for the employee, 401(k) with employer contribution, 2 weeks of PTO annually to start, and a stipend for your home internet.

How to apply

The first step is really easy and only takes 10 minutes — no resume, no cover letter, no essays. Here's how:

  1. Take this online Culture Index assessment (about 10 minutes): We use it to screen for people whose natural wiring fits how our team works.

  2. If your profile lines up with what we're looking for, we'll reach out and ask you to complete a 60-minute TestGorilla assessment for critical thinking skills, send us your resume, and maybe a couple of other items.

  3. From there, we conduct between 2-4 video interviews. One of these might be a live technical assessment.

If the Culture Index step feels like a strange way to start a job application — that's kind of the point. Remember the phrase Think Different?

Ignition is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and will consider all qualified applicants. Good luck in your search — and may the Force be with you!

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ignition-inc-msp-mac-help-desk-guru-work-from-home
